steps.title: Fighting Chronozon
steps.content:
thumb|573x573px|Chronozon is located next to the Earth Obelisk marked on the map.
- *Teleport to Varrock (lumberyard teleport), and head north-east to the Jolly Boar Inn near the lumberyard. Go upstairs and speak to Johnathon. Speak to him, and use your anti-poison on him to learn the location of the final crest piece.
*Prepare for the fight:
**Bring runes for each of the four blast spells: Wind Blast, Water Blast, Earth Blast, and Fire Blast as you need to deal damage with each spell.
**'''Be aware that Chronozon's fight takes place in part of the Wilderness and other players may attack you there.'
**Maging is recommended. You will have to kill a poison spider to use the safespots, so anti-poison is recommended. 
**Diary tasks: Since Chronozon is at the Earth Obelisk and the Air Obelisk is to the north, you can bring two Unpowered orbs, 6 Cosmic runes, 60 Earth runes,  60 air runes to respectively complete a medium and hard Wilderness task (with 60/66 Magic).
*Go to Edgeville or the small hut west of Varrock if you have a brass key to enter the Edgeville Dungeon.
*Head to the gate dividing the Wilderness from the rest of the dungeon.
*Travel slightly north, then make a left past the thugs and Chaos druids, through a second gate.
*Travel west, then south past the poison spiders and Black demons, where you will find Chronozon.
*Safespot him between the southern rocks. You may have to kill a poison spider first.
**You must successfully'' cast each blast spell on Chronozon (No splashes or zeroes. Twinflame Staff will prohibit you from changing spells). 
**Once he has been weakened by each blast spell, kill him with any spell, melee, or ranged.
*Pick up the last crest piece and teleport out.
*Assemble the Family crest and head back to Dimintheis in Varrock to conclude.
*Congratulations, quest complete!

**If you have a ring of charos (a), it will only cost 10 ecto-tokens by using the (Charm) option when speaking to the ghost captain. 
*Once there, use the map to find the treasure starting at the statue (or use the image on the right to find it). Dig with your spade, and you will find the book of haricanto.

steps.title: Starting out
steps.content: - *Talk to the Zealot outside the mine.

steps.title: Cave level 1
steps.content:
- *Run directly west through the cave and crawl-through the cart tunnel.
*Re-enter the cave via the southern entrance.
*Descend the nearby ladder.

steps.title: Cave level 2
steps.content: - *Go down the ladder directly east.

steps.title: Cave level 3
steps.content:
- *Avoid touching mine carts.
*Go south along the moving cart's tracks using the alcove for cover, then slightly west.
*Climb down the ladder.

steps.title: Cave level 4
steps.content:
thumb|220px|The mine cart route solution.
thumb|220px|Levers A-E. Camera facing west.
thumb|220px|Levers F-K. Camera facing east.
- *Pick a glowing fungus. Don't take any random events that teleport you out of the mine from now on or your fungus will turn to ash.
*Go NW and place the fungus in the searchable cart.
*Go NW to check the points settings. (Board on a wall)
- *Write down which levers need to change to match the correct setting to get to the ladder in the top-right corner.
**The initial configuration will be different for each player. See pictures for the correct configuration and labels on each lever.
*Go south-east and pull the needed levers (between A-E).
*Go north-west and pull the needed levers (between F-K).
*Return to the point settings and click start.
If you mess up and the cart does not reach the ladder, you will need to grab another fungus, put it in the mine cart, and send it down the track before continuing.

steps.title: Finding the cart again
steps.content:
- *Leave the cave by going back the way you came
**Go up the ladder by the glowing fungus spawn.
**Go north past the haunted cart, then the first wing east, climb up the ladder.
**Go west, climb up the ladder.
**Go west and exit the cave.
*Crawl-down the Cart tunnel to the north
*Climb down the nearby ladder.
*Go NE and climb down the ladder by the door.
*Go west then north and climb down the ladder.
*Search the cart for the fungus and take it. Do not drop until you have completed the quest!

steps.title: Water valve
steps.content:
- *Climb up the ladder and start saving your run energy after you turn the water valve in the next step.
*Go all the way east then south past the moving cart.
*Climb down the ladder.
*Head south and use the Zealot's key on the water valve.
**Note: If you forgot a chisel be sure to grab the one near the lift before you open the valve; you won't have enough time to pick it up while running there.
*Quickly run to the lift and take it down.
*Go south then East and down the stairs.
*Go through the door.
*Pick up the innocent-looking key to start the boss fight.
*Kill Treus Dayth. It is recommended to pray Protect from Missiles throughout the fight. A good way to fight this boss is to run near him after attacking; the goal is to force him into the north-eastern corner. Once this occurs, run west to the end of the detached northern shaft and attack him from a distance. This prevents him from teleporting around the mine while also negating crane damage, which should make the fight easier.
**Note: If you teleport away, you will have to get another Glowing fungus. 
**Note: If you die, you cannot get the Glowing fungus back from your grave in the flooded area. This is not a safe fight.
**Note: If you are following the Optimal Quest Guide, using Crumble Undead is the most effective way to kill this boss.
*Pick up the key 
*Go back up the eastern stairs.
*Go west and down those stairs. You will need the Glowing fungus to act as a light source.
*Open the door and cut the crystal outcrop to the south-east with your chisel.
*Congratulations, quest complete!

*Players can use a ball of wool on a salve shard to make a salve amulet.
*The crystal-mine key, obtained after killing Treus Dayth, can be added to the steel key ring.
*Unless the player has a low defence or prayer level, it is often more efficient to tank the crane hits and rush the boss directly than it is to spend time navigating the area.
*Mining mithril ore within the abandoned mine is a hard task in the Morytania Diary. steps.content:
To fight the Black Knight Titan, bring armour, Excalibur, food, and one magic whistle. Note he is extremely resistant to Ranged and Magic, so melee is recommended. Bring antipoison if your combat level is lower than 41. You can use another weapon for a majority of the fight with the Black Knight Titan, but you must use Excalibur for the last hits. Note: He will heal to full health if your last attack is with something other than the Excalibur.

- *Prepare for the fight against the Black Knight Titan.
*Travel north-west of Brimhaven to the north-western peninsula (see the minimap image).
*Stand under the tower and blow a magic whistle to be teleported to the Fisher Realm.
*Fight the Black Knight Titan nearby on the bridge and kill the titan with Excalibur. See the in-depth quest guide for details.
*Head south along the river and talk to the fisherman.  (Make sure to talk to him about both options or you will have to kill the Black Knight Titan again if you leave.)
}}

steps.title: Starting out
The first flashback
steps.content:
thumb|250px|Solution
: You cannot teleport out of this area! There are aggressive Level 84 Mummies scattered throughout the map, and Scarabs that can inflict poison (it is possible to run past the scarabs without taking damage or being poisoned by spam-clicking the minimap). If you need to leave you must walk back to the entrance and use the ladder.
- *Navigate by clicking the minimap to automatically avoid the traps.
*Jump the pit (20% minimum energy required, higher Agility increases your chances).
*Go west and open the door.
*Click on the large golden bird to reset the puzzle until it lands on the solution shown in the image on this page. Then click the tiles indicated on the picture.

steps.title: The sphinx
The second flashback
steps.content:
- *Return to the pyramid (right-click door and open) and jump the pit again to trigger the next flashback.
*Open the western door (directly south of you) and take the canopic jar back (you can only pick up the correct one).
*A level 75 or 81 enemy (see the guardians in the info box above) will appear, kill it and take the jar.
*Leave the room and jump across the pit.
*Jump back across the pit.
*Solve the western door puzzle and drop the jar where you found it.
*Leave the room again and jump across the pit once more.
*Exit the pyramid via the entrance ladder.

steps.title: Preparing for the ceremony
steps.content: - *Talk to the High Priest.

steps.title: The third flashback
steps.content:
- *Enter the pyramid (right click, open door).
*Jump the gap again to trigger the 3rd flashback.
*Enter the east door and use the holy/unholy symbol on any sarcophagus. Exit the room.
*Jump back across the pit and enter the eastern room again.
*Kill the level 91 Possessed Priest.
*Talk to the High Priest.

steps.title: The fourth flashback
steps.content:
- *Exit the pyramid.
*Talk to the High Priest in the temple.
*Congratulations, quest complete!

steps.title: Character customization
steps.content:
thumb|left|200px|The first house on the island.
Upon logging in to the game for the first time after account creation, players will find themselves in a house in the centre of Tutorial Island. The Character Creator interface will be open, which allows setting their character's appearance, such as body type, skin colour, and clothing styles. All of these customisation options can later be altered through Makeover for free after leaving Tutorial Island.

steps.title: Adventure Paths
steps.content: After customizing your appearance, you will be asked how familiar you are with Old School Runescape. To use the Adventure Paths system, you must indicate that you are either brand new, or have played in the past but not recently. Adventure Paths offer basic rewards such as Mithril equipment as you complete beginner tasks on your account, for example reaching a certain level in a skill. More information on the system will be given after leaving Tutorial Island.

steps.title: Gielinor Guide
steps.content:
left|frameless|80px
Throughout the tutorial, the game will indicate the next action to take with a flashing arrow visible both in the game world and on the minimap, starting with the Gielinor Guide. To move around, simply left click on the ground or on the minimap. To interact with objects and non-player characters in the game world, you may either left click on them to use their primary action, or right click to open the options menu which may contain several actions.

Left click on the Gielinor Guide to talk to him and he will ask you to open the Settings interface, the spanner icon in the bottom right bar. You must open it to continue, but browsing it is optional. Talk to the Gielinor Guide again, who wants you to visit the first instructor.

steps.title: Survival Expert
steps.content:
left|frameless|70px
:Note: The compass just above the minimap indicates the cardinal direction based on your camera angle. The wiki will often use these directions to guide you.

Exit through the door to the east by interacting with it. Talk to the Survival Expert to the south, who will give you a small fishing net and ask you to catch some shrimp in the nearby pond; but first, he wants you to view the net in your inventory. Open the Inventory interface by selecting the backpack icon from the bottom right bar. To fish, you can either use the fishing net on the fishing spot by left clicking the net and then the fishing spot, or simply left click the fishing spot to use it automatically.

Once you catch a shrimp, you will gain some Fishing experience, and the tutorial will prompt you to open the Skills interface. Once you've opened it, talk to the Survival Expert again, who will give you a bronze axe and tinderbox and ask you to make a fire to cook the shrimp on.

Chop down any nearby tree to obtain some logs, then use the tinderbox on the logs to light them and create a fire. Finally, use the shrimps on the fire to cook them.

steps.title: Master Chef
steps.content:
left|frameless|60px
Exit through the gate to the west and head to the nearby house, opening the door to enter. Talk to the Master Chef, who will give you a pot of flour and a bucket of water and ask you to cook some bread. To make the bread, use the pot of flour on the bucket of water to make some bread dough, then either use the bread dough on the nearby range or simply left click on the range.

steps.title: Quest Guide
steps.content:
left|frameless|80px
Exit through the north-western door and follow the path to enter the next house. Talk to the Quest Guide, who wants you to open the Quest List interface. After opening it, talk to the Quest Guide again, who will explain more about questing in Gielinor.

steps.title: Mining Instructor
steps.content:
left|frameless|80px
Climb down the ladder in the south-east corner of the room, and talk to the Mining Instructor to the north. He will give you a bronze pickaxe and ask you to mine some tin and copper. Mine the tin rocks to the west until you receive tin ore, then mine the copper rocks to the east until you receive copper ore. Use one of the ores on the furnace to the south, or simply left click on the furnance to smelt the ore into a bronze bar. Speak to the mining instructor again, who will give you a hammer and ask you to make a bronze dagger using the nearby anvil. Use the bronze bar on it or simply left click on the anvil, then select the dagger to create one.

steps.title: Combat Instructor
steps.content:
left|frameless|80px
Exit through the gate to the east and talk to the Combat Instructor, who wants you to wield your dagger. Select the icon of a man in the bottom right bar to view your worn items, then click the bottom left icon to view your equipment stats. Click your bronze dagger in the inventory to equip it in the weapon slot.

Talk to the Combat Instructor again, who will give you a bronze sword and wooden shield. Left click on the bronze sword in your inventory to equip it, unequipping the dagger in the process, and left click on your bronze shield to equip it in the shield slot.

Open the Combat Options interface by clicking the crossed swords icon on the bottom right interface, which will display the different attack styles you can use with your weapon. Enter the rat pit through the gate, and left click a rat to kill it. Return to the Combat Instructor, who will give you a shortbow and 50 bronze arrows. Equip both, and kill another rat from outside the pen.

steps.title: Account Guide
steps.content:
left|frameless|80px
Climb up the ladder to the east, and enter the nearby building to use the bank booth, which will display your bank containing 25 coins. Use the poll booth on the western wall to learn about the poll system for adding future content to the game. Enter the eastern door and talk to the Account Guide, who will ask you to open the Account Management interface. Click the icon of a man's face with a cog to view it, then talk to the Account Guide again, who will teach you about Membership, Worlds, Bonds, and other aspects of having an account.

steps.title: Brother Brace
steps.content:
left|frameless|80px
Exit through the door to the east, and follow the path to the next house to talk to Brother Brace, who wants you to open the Prayer interface. Select the star icon in the bottom right bar to view it, then talk to Brother Brace again, who will teach you about activating Prayers and burying bones for Prayer experience.

steps.title: Magic Instructor
steps.content:
left|frameless|70px
Exit through the door to the south and enter the building to the south-east. Talk to the Magic Instructor, who wants you to open the Magic interface. Select the spellbook icon in the bottom right bar to view your spells. Talk to the instructor again, who will give you some air runes and mind runes to cast Wind Strike on the chickens in the northern pen. Select Wind Strike in the Magic interface and then click on the chicken to cast the spell.

Congratulations, quest complete!

After completing the quest, talk to the Magic Instructor and he will tell you to cast the Lumbridge Home Teleport spell to teleport to Lumbridge. He will ask whether you want to talk to the Ironman tutor first before leaving, who would teach you about the Ironman mode. If you wish to participate in this mode's account restrictions, you must talk to the tutor before leaving.

* is also the name of the tutorial quest that briefly replaced Tutorial Island in RuneScape 2 between 14 July and 15 September 2008, as well as Tutorial Island itself between 14 September 2008 and 17 September 2009. Any players who created their accounts prior to the former update would also have the Learning the Ropes quest journal detail Tutorial Island.
*The Tutorial Island quest was initially listed under its own subsection within the Quest Tab named "Tutorial Island" below the Miniquests subsection, before the quest was renamed to "Learning the Ropes".

''Items needed: Yommi totem, Radimus notes, bullroarer, combat equipment, axe & machete (if you banked before fight) (You need the sacred water and seeds at this step since the totem isn't created yet.)
- *Skills needed: 45 Herblore (boostable)'' Use the germinated seeds on the fertile soil patch (8 steps north and 5 steps west of the pool). Note: It is possible to be unsuccessful when planting the seeds. Plant the seeds again until a sapling grows. If more seeds are needed, visit the cave and speak to Ungadulu for more.
*Once planted, the yommi bush will grow leaves. Use the sacred water on it and it will become an adult yommi tree.
*Use your axe on the adult yommi tree. Use your axe on the downed tree twice to make it into a totem.
**

steps.title: Finishing up
steps.content:
Items needed: Gilded totem, Radimus notes
- *Talk to Radimus at the Legends Guild (fairy ring

*Dragon Slayer II
*Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Sir Amik Varze (you only need to have started Legends' Quest to talk to Radimus Erkle about Recipe for Disaster)
*Ardougne Diary (Hard)

Lost City.name: Lost City
Lost City.requirements:
*  
*  
*Ability to kill a level 101 Tree spirit with limited armour and weapons.

items.name: Woodcutting
items.note: you will need to bank the axe before accessing Entrana - you cannot use a blessed axe

items.name: Food
items.note: armour is not allowed on Entrana

items.name: Prayer potion
items.note: Prayer is almost fully drained when entering the dungeon

items.name: Ranged
items.note: not recommended for the Tree spirit

items.name: teleport
items.note: the only alternative is to leave via the Magic Door to level 32 wilderness

Lost City.itemsRaw:
* Knife
* Woodcutting axe (you will need to bank the axe before accessing Entrana - you cannot use a blessed axe)
Lost City.recommendedRaw:
* 
*Weight-reducing clothing and stamina or energy potions
*Food (armour is not allowed on Entrana)
*If using Magic for the Entrana Dungeon (recommended):
**  Magic and enough runes to cast Fire Strike for the Tree Spirit which has a 35% Fire weakness OR
** Magic and enough runes to cast Crumble Undead against the Zombies and the Tree Spirit, who are susceptible to it (about 65 casts should be enough)
** A Celastrus bark to fletch into a battlestaff for the added Magic bonus (requires  Fletching)
* If using Melee for the Entrana Dungeon:
** Prayer potion (Prayer is almost fully drained when entering the dungeon)
** Rings of recoil
*If using Ranged as an alternative to Magic against the Zombies (not recommended for the Tree spirit):
**Arrows, bow string and an unstrung bow
*Fast travel to several locations:
**Lumbridge Swamp to start the quest (plus one additional trip) - Necklace of passage or Ring of the elements or Amulet of glory or Lumbridge Teleport
**Entrana (1 trip) - Monk of Entrana on the second northern dock at Port Sarim or Balloon transport system.
**An instant teleport to leave the Entrana Dungeon (the only alternative is to leave via the Magic Door to level 32 wilderness)
Lost City.enemies:
* Tree Spirit (level 101) (Safespottable)  
* Multiple Zombies (level 25) (for a bronze axe)
Lost City.start: Go to Lumbridge Swamp. Talk to the campers there.

steps.content:
- *Speak to the Warrior north-west of Lumbridge Swamp. 
*Bank your axe. Bring items to make weapons or bows. Runes and food can be taken to Entrana. It is recommended to bring a teleportation method as well.
**If you already have the required items you can go directly to Port Sarim and use the bank deposit box on the dock.
**Bank all weapons and armour. You're allowed to take jewellery such as the ring of dueling, amulet of glory, combat bracelet, etc...
**If you don't have a teleportation method, purchase a chronicle from Diango and charge it with teleport cards.
*Go to the Port Sarim docks, south of the Rusty Anchor Inn.
*Talk to a Monk of Entrana and travel to Entrana.
*Cross the north-east bridge then go west until you see the Cave monk, go down the ladder. (Note: Do not craft battlestaff or bow before you enter cave. Otherwise you will be knocked out and returned to Port Sarim)
Warning: there are two Greater Demons (Level 92) in the room before the Dramen tree.
*Kill zombies until they drop a bronze axe (about 40% drop chance per kill). 

Caution: If you go through the magical door, you will be teleported into level 32 Wilderness.
*Go south-east past the demons and attempt to chop the tree.

*Kill the Dramen Tree Spirit (there is a safespot behind the southern fungus formation).
**Note: Do not use the mushroom by the demons outside of the room as a safespot. Even if you kill the tree spirit, they will respawn again after trying to cut the tree!
*Chop the tree and use a knife on the branch obtained to make the dramen staff.
**Note: A dramen branch is required for the Freeing Sir Amik Varze subquest of Recipe for Disaster, and another is useful for the smuggling into Thorvald's trial in The Fremennik Trials, but do not make them into staves yet. Cutting at least three branches is recommended.
*Teleport out and go to the tool shed in the centre of Lumbridge Swamp.
*Wield a dramen staff and enter the tool shed.
*Congratulations, quest complete!
}}

Completion of Lost City is required for the following quests:
* Fairytale I - Growing Pains
* Heroes' Quest
* Lunar Diplomacy
* Freeing Sir Amik Varze
* Lumbridge & Draynor Medium Diary
* Lumbridge & Draynor Hard Diary
Completion of Lost City is also required for:
* Slayer Master Chaeldar

Lunar Diplomacy.itemsRaw:
*A tinderbox
*A few coins (1,000 is enough)
*A guam leaf (common drop from a Suqah during the quest)
*A marrentill (common drop from a Suqah during the quest)
*A pestle and mortar
*A hammer (or an Imcando hammer)
*A needle (a costume needle will also work) and 2 spools of thread.
*Any axe (bronze axe obtainable during quest)
*Any pickaxe
*A spade
*A finished bullseye lantern (NOT (unf) NOR (empty). If you cannot obtain one, bring Swamp tar to a lamp oil still instead. Swamp tar can be obtained during the quest.)
*All elemental talismans or their respective tiaras (Air, Water, Earth, and Fire, or an Elemental talisman), or access to the Abyss or the Guardians of the Rift minigame
*A dramen staff
*Combat equipment
Lunar Diplomacy.recommendedRaw:
*
*Fast travel to Rellekka: Enchanted lyre (obtained during The Fremennik Trials), Fremennik sea boots, Rellekka teleport tablets, fairy ring (code ), or Camelot Teleport and run
*Fast travel to each of the elemental altars (either via the Abyss, the Guardians of the Rift, or to the Air near the Crafting Guild, Fire near the Emir's Arena, Water in Lumbridge Swamp, Earth near the Sawmill)
*Extra dramen staves (if interested in making more lunar staves for free)
If you cannot obtain a bullseye lantern, bring:
*Teleport to House runes/tablet (if POH is in Rimmington, redirection scrolls if not) or other means to get to Rimmington.

This is expensive but to save time you can also bring Ring of the elements to teleport to all of the altars as well as use an Elemental tiara to save 8 inventory slots.

steps.title: Starting out
steps.content:
- *Talk to Lokar Searunner on the western most Rellekka docks. 
*Return to Lokar Searunner. 
*Climb the ladders, and board the pirate ship. Talk to Captain Bentley about sailing to Lunar Isle. 
*Speak to Captain Bentley again.
*Climb down the nearby south stairs through the door, talk to 'Birds-Eye' Jack.
*Climb back up the stairs and talk to Captain Bentley again. 
*Climb back down the stairs and return to 'Birds-Eye' Jack again.
}}

steps.title: Talking to the crew
steps.content:
NOTE: You must talk to them in order.
- *Talk to 'Eagle-eye' Shultz at the very front (north-end) of the ship.
*Talk to the Cabin boy up one deck from the captain (south).
*Talk to 'Beefy' Burns on the lowest level of the ship.
*Talk to 'Lecherous' Lee at the very top-rear of the ship.
*Talk to First mate 'Davey-boy', on the deck level, south room.
*Climb back up to the top, talk to the Cabin boy (2 inventory spaces required).

steps.title: Searching for clues
steps.content:
- *Use the emerald lens on the bullseye lantern you brought. Light it with your tinderbox.
**If you didn't bring a lightable lantern, you can make lamp oil in Rimmington and add it to the bullseye lantern (unf) given by the Cabin boy, after using the emerald lens on it. If you lose your emerald lens for any reason, you can ask the Cabin boy for another one.
**If you still own a sapphire lantern from the Tears of Guthix quest, you can use the emerald lens on the sapphire lantern.
*Use the lantern on the following objects, and rub away the symbols:
**Cannon: Eastern cannon a few steps away (same level as Cabin boy).
**Wallchart: Climb down the stairs, southern-most room (on the wallchart north of the long wooden table).
**Chest: Lowest level of the ship, northern chest.
**Support pillar: Also lowest level, just north of Beefy Burns, the cook.
**Crate: Directly east of the cooking range.
*Talk to Captain Bentley.

steps.title: Lunar Isle
steps.content:
- *Climb down the ladders and walk into the city (there will be a small cut-scene).
*Run out of the city to the south-east part of the island. Talk to the Oneiromancer.
*Kill Suqah (safespottable), until you've received a suqah tooth. Keep any hides you get as drops (you will need a total of 4 hides later in the quest, which you can also collect later).
*Return to the city, northern section. Enter the chicken house and talk to Baba Yaga (1 inventory space required).

steps.title: Lunar Staff
steps.content:
Note:  if using fairy rings, you can not use lunar staves for fairy ring transport at this point in the quest.
- *Use your Dramen staff/staves on the following altars in order:
**Air Altar (south of Falador).
**Fire Altar (north of Al Kharid entrance of Emir's Arena).
**Water Altar (Lumbridge Swamp).
**Earth Altar (north-east of Varrock).
*Travel back to Lunar Isle and give the Lunar staff to the Oneiromancer. Do not forget to bring your seal of passage.

steps.title: Ceremonial clothes
steps.content:
thumb|220px|Mining the stalagmite for the Lunar helm|helm.- *In the north-eastern part of the isle, climb down ladder to the Lunar Mine.
*Mine a stalagmite for 1 lunar ore. Grab three extra ores to save time during The Fremennik Exiles quest.
*Smelt the ore at a furnace or superheat the ore to receive a lunar bar (closest furnace and anvil is in Rellekka).
*With a hammer, use the bar on an anvil to make the helm.
*Go back to the Lunar Isle.
*North-west in the city, talk to Pauline Polaris (1 inventory space required) Note: The chat options appear in a random order when guessing her real name. First guess must be Pauline. Pick the option that says "Jane Blud-Hagic-Maid." 
*South in the city, talk to Meteora.
*Kill Suqahs until one drops a special tiara. Keep up to 4 hides the Suqahs drop. Make sure you have at least 4 hides.
*Give Meteora the tiara.
*South of the bank, talk to Rimae Sirsalis about ceremonial clothes. 
*Craft a Lunar torso, trousers, gloves and boots from your hides.
thumb|300px|Lunar ring location
*Centre of the city, talk to Selene. 
*Exit the city and run south then west past the two bridges. With your spade, dig up the blue flowers furthest west to receive the lunar ring. (You must click continue on the chatbox!)
*Give the Oneiromancer all your lunar gear. She will then give you all the items back. You will need to have 11 inventory spaces free (8 for your lunar gear and 3 other spaces) or you cannot continue.}}

steps.title: Dreamville
steps.content:
- *Use the Waking sleep vial on the kindling you received.
*Get your combat runes and supplies and wear all your lunar items (but do NOT bank your seal of passage). 4 inventory spaces are required.
*Enter a long building on the western side of the village that has a ceremonial brazier and a staircase inside.
*Light the ceremonial brazier then use the kindling on it.
*Talk to the Ethereal Being.
*If you logout during the dream state you will have to speak to the Oneiromancer again to retrieve the Waking sleep vial and kindling.

steps.title: =Dicing=
steps.content:
- *Step on the south-western yellow platform.
*Talk to Ethereal Fluke.
*He will call out a number, you need to make the dice add up to the number he called. Roll the dice for the numbers in the answer that are not on the dice. E.g. for number 12, roll any dice that are numbers 4, 5 or 6.

steps.title: =The race=
steps.content:
- *Step on the eastern grey platform.
*Talk to Ethereal Expert and start the race.

steps.title: =Copy cat=
steps.content:
- *Step on the south-eastern green platform.
*Talk to Ethereal Mimic.

steps.title: =Defeating Me=
steps.content: - *Talk to the Ethereal Being to begin the final fight.

steps.title: Finishing up
steps.content:
- *Read the lectern to return to Lunar Isle.
*With the seal of passage equipped or in your inventory talk to the Oneiromancer.
*Congratulations, quest complete!

Items required: None.
Items recommended: Weight-reducing clothing and stamina potions, a teleport to Rellekka, Draynor Village, Dramen or Lunar staff, food for next part unless banking.
- *Talk to Burntmeat located in the Troll Stronghold kitchen (stairs to the south after entering). if boosts are being used.
*Talk to My Arm located by the herb patch on the roof of the Troll Stronghold (ladder up to the west or Agility shortcut.
*Talk to Larry (Fairy ring code  then run to the transportation symbol on the coast to the north, east of Rellekka), or  if you no longer have the clockwork book
*Talk to Larry again., or  if you no longer have the clockwork book
*Board the boat.
}}

steps.title: Troll Diplomacy
steps.content:
Items required: Any pickaxe and rope (both obtainable during this part), Mining and Agility level boost (if necessary).Items recommended: Weight-reducing clothing and stamina potions, a teleport to Draynor Village (at least 2 teleport uses, such as an amulet of glory(2) ), food for failing obstacles.
thumb|Safe spot halfway through the thrower troll section.
- If you did not bring a rope, search the wrecked boat for one. Take a pickaxe too as you'll need it later.
*Attempt to mine the cave entrance (do not use your boost yet if you brought one)
*Climb up the rockslides nearby (boosting to 68 Agility if necessary), and use a rope on the tree.
*Climb the rope and cross the ledge.
*Climb the last rockslide and pass the fallen tree.
*Talk to Boulder. 
*After Snowflake leaves, pick all possible options.
*Talk to My Arm.
}}

steps.title: The Wise "Dead" Man
Matricide
steps.content:
''Items required: Combat equipment (preferably Ranged), food and potions as they can hit through Prayer, Old man's coffin''

- *Return to Weiss by travelling with Larry's boat.
*Go through the cave entrance.
*Talk to My Arm by the north entrance.
*Talk to Odd Mushroom.
*Fight Don't Know What. Use Protect from Missiles and damage him with melee or Ranged.
*Fight Mother. Activate Protect from Missiles. Grab a bucket from the pile and use it on the large barrel of water. Then use the bucket of water on the Fire of Domination to extinguish it, which then makes your attacks effective. Mother will stun the player and drain some Prayer points if able to get into melee range, therefore it's preferred to fight back with Ranged while running from Mother. He can also be safespotted by trapping him east of the staircase and standing immediately south of the stairs in the western-most square.
}}

steps.title: A New Leader
steps.content:
Items required: Bucket
- *Talk to My Arm.
*Talk to the Wise Old Man, and then Snowflake.

steps.title: Riddle 1
steps.content:
- *If needed, take the knife from the table.
*Attempt to open the door with the pink knob to the north.
*Take the note on the ground next to you and read it.
*Go to the room south-west from the entry hall, and use the knife on the painting with the gloomy valley on the east wall.
*Search the slashed painting to obtain a ruby key.
*Go to the room south-east from the entry hall. If needed, take a tinderbox from the shelves.
*Use the tinderbox on the four unlit candles throughout the eastern room.
*Use the tinderbox on the barrel with the fuse.
*Exit the room to trigger the explosion.

steps.title: Riddle 2
steps.content:
- *Re-enter the south-east room and climb over the damaged wall.
*Head north, then west, and click "observe" on the tree across from Lacey.
*Pick any chat option the Killer gives you; the answer does not matter.
*Take the note and read it.
*Play the notes D-E-A-D on the piano in the north-eastern corner of the manor.
*Search the piano to get an emerald key.

steps.title: Riddle 3
steps.content:
- *Return to the mansion via the damaged wall.
*Open the door with the green knob north of the entrance, west of the door with the pink knob.
*Attempt to open the door to the west with the Bandos godsword inside.
*Take the note and read it.
*Head through the south-eastern room with the damaged wall, then to the room north of it. Use the knife on the unlit fireplace.
*Search the fireplace and enter the following gems in this order:Sapphire – Diamond – Zenyte – Emerald – Onyx – Ruby.
*Search the fireplace again to get the sapphire key.

steps.title: Showdown
steps.content:
- *Open the westernmost door with the blue knob in the room where you slashed the painting.
*The killer will hide in wardrobes and throw knives. The player can know which wardrobe the killer is hiding in by looking for a brief black shadow surrounding the wardrobe. You must push the mirror and have it face the wardrobe before a knife is thrown. Repeat this until a cutscene.

*Attempt to exit the room.

steps.title: Ape Atoll
steps.content:
center|thumb|500px|A map of Ape Atoll marking the quest NPCs and routes. Keep this map handy!
Note: You will need to teleport away and return to the island several times.
To get back to the Grand Tree, use a Ring of dueling to teleport to the Al Kharid PvP Arena, then take the Al Kharid gnome glider.

*You may wish to keep Protect from Melee prayer on at all times, switching to Protect from Missiles prayer when you get near the gate (where indicated).
*If at any point in the island you have the guards called on you, it is recommended to log out or hop worlds to avoid going back to jail.
The escape route.|thumb
- *On the island, follow the red path on the map into the valley. You will be shot and arrested.
*Watch the guards' pattern, pick the lock on your cell door and escape the prison.
**Stay at least 2 squares away from the guards even while in the cell.
*Follow the green path and talk to Garkor (Complete dialogue or Zooknock will not give you the m'speak amulet).

steps.title: Obtaining amulet parts
steps.content:
thumb|250px|M'amulet mould location.
- *Follow the blue path to the U-shaped building and enter through the southern door.
**Stay on the dark brown floor or you will alert the guards.
*Search the stacked crates on the light brown floor for Monkey dentures. (Complete the dialogue)
*Search the south-eastern crate to fall into a cave.

steps.title: Meeting Zooknock
steps.content:
thumb|center|670px|The Ape Atoll dungeon map.

- *Now is an ideal time to resupply at a bank before heading into the Ape Atoll Dungeon.
*Return to Ape Atoll by talking to Daero, Waydar, and Lumdo.
*Follow the yellow path west and climb down the ladder into the Ape Atoll Dungeon.
*Run to the end of the dungeon.
**Use Protect from Melee prayer and ignore all the hazards, eating food and drinking potions as needed.
*Talk to Zooknock.
*Use your Monkey dentures, M'amulet mould, and Gold bar on Zooknock.
**Talk to Zooknock to get an Enchanted bar and your M'amulet mould back.
**Do not use the m'amulet mould on Zooknock when you already have the enchanted bar, otherwise he will keep it and you will have to obtain another. 
*Teleport away, then return by talking to Daero, Waydar, and Lumdo.
*Follow the red path, get arrested, escape, then follow the pink path to the temple.
*(Note: bearded guards cannot be walked through!) Enter the trapdoor. You may need to climb up the ladder to the south then down in the east to avoid the gorillas.
*With a M'amulet mould in your inventory, use the Enchanted bar with a wall of flames, then string it with your Ball of wool to create the M'speak amulet.
*Optional: If you plan on doing the Freeing King Awowogei section of Recipe for Disaster:
**Kill one of the Monkey Zombies and pick up the zombie monkey bones.
**Climb back up the rope, kill one of the Monkey Guards and pick up the gorilla bones.
***If you're having trouble with the guard, stay out of melee range so it doesn't heal.

steps.title: Well I'll be a monkey's uncle
steps.content:
- *Follow the pink path back to the jail, then the cyan path to the Monkey child's house.
**Keep an eye on The Monkey's Aunt, it's only safe to be in the garden while she isn't near it.
*Equip your M'speak amulet and talk to the monkey child.
*Talk to the monkey child twice more. 
**Leave the garden, hop worlds or wait for the monkey child to stop crying.
**Talk to the monkey child again. 
**Repeat the above steps until you have four Monkey talisman in total.
**If doing Freeing King Awowogei section, climb the ladder in the east building from Child, cross bridge east and there will be Monkey Archers you can kill and pick up one set of ninja monkey bones}}

steps.title: The greegree
steps.content:
- *Teleport away, then return by talking to Daero, Waydar, and Lumdo.
**Now is an ideal time to resupply at a bank for the Ape Atoll dungeon.
**Bring good Food, as well as Prayer, Antipoison, and Stamina/Energy potions.
*Follow the yellow path west and climb down the ladder.
*Run to the end of the dungeon.
**Use Protect from Melee prayer and ignore all the hazards, eating food and drinking potions as needed.
*Give Zooknock your Monkey talisman and Monkey bones (make sure these are bones from the regular monkeys; examine Text: These are small monkey bones.). After a moment he will give you a Greegree.
**Do not accidentally bury the bones! Right click them and carefully select "use".
**Do not leave the dialogue with Zooknock prematurely. Should the player exit the cutscene before it has finished, talking to Zooknock again will restart the cutscene, and no items will be lost.
*Optional: If you plan on doing the Freeing King Awowogei section of Recipe for Disaster:
**Talk to Zooknock again.

steps.title: An audience with King Awowogei
steps.content:
- *Head to the Ardougne Zoo and equip your Karamjan monkey greegree, then talk to the Monkey minder. If you haven't talked to him before, click through his dialogue (ask any question), then equip the Karamjan monkey greegree.
*Equip your M'speak amulet and talk to a monkey, it will jump in your bag.
*Remove your greegree and talk to the minder again.
*Travel by foot (walk or run) back to the Grand Tree, then return to Ape Atoll by talking to Daero, Waydar, and Lumdo. Do not use any means of teleportation.
*Equip your M'speak amulet and Karamjan monkey greegree. Ape Atoll is no longer your enemy when wearing a greegree!
*If you want to skip going to talk to Kruk and you brought mithril seeds or tinderbox and logs you can stand on the east side of the Elder Guard and plant the mithril seeds or light a fire to be force moved one tile west and thus bypass needing to talk to Kruk or to Garkor.
*Follow the red path, go through the gates, then walk east to the coast and talk to Garkor.
*Talk to the nearby Elder Guard.
*Head to the west coast of the island (orange path), then climb up the hill to the south.
*Climb the ladder, walk across the bridge, climb down, and talk to Kruk.
*Talk to Awowogei.
*Talk to Awowogei again. Then talk to the Elder Guard again to be let out.
*Talk to Garkor and watch the cutscene.
*Talk to Garkor again to get the 10th squad sigil.

steps.title: The final battle
steps.content:
- *Prepare for final battle.
*Equip the 10th squad sigil when you are ready to fight the Jungle Demon.
**Tip: Use Protect from Magic prayer and stay out of melee range to avoid taking damage.
*Kill the Jungle Demon.
*Return to the Grand Tree and talk to King Narnode Shareen.
*Congratulations, quest complete!

Below is a map of Kruk's Dungeon. You have two different routes that they can take through the dungeon - one through the agility section of the dungeon (starting at the dodgy ground a little bit south), and one that goes through a series of rooms filled with aggressive mobs using both Melee and Ranged (extreme south). The player may choose which route to take, but the exact routes in each room varies from player to player - in each section/room there are two possible exits and only one will be correct for your player. 
thumb|600px|centre|If you fall into the lower levels of the dungeon while failing an agility obstacle, you will fall into a pit that is filled with maniacal monkeys in a multi-combat area. Pray melee immediately or you will die.

- *Navigate the maze via the agility path to the east or the tank pathway to the south. You will be able to create a shortcut after the maze, allowing for banking. It is very easy to die here if you are not careful and paying attention to which prayers you need to use. Prayer potions and good food are highly recommended for this.
*It is recommended to consult the map to follow the right route towards the end.

steps.title: = On the agility path:''' =
steps.content:
- * If you fail an obstacle and receive a message '...this route feels wrong', you have to take the other path instead.
* You will come across areas throughout the agility path that contain Dodgy Ground, such as at the start of the path. The trick here is to only walk on the tiles that do NOT appear cracked, since otherwise you will fall down. These are fairly easily distinguishable as the "cracked ground" tiles look as if they have slightly darker cracks in the shape of an "X" on each tile, while the safer tiles look smooth and uncracked.

Note: if using a 3rd party client, be sure to disable display settings such as Low Detail plugins, as it can cause graphical issues while doing the agility path.

* Throughout this path, as soon as you inevitably fall down, you will want to immediately pray either against melee or ranged, respectively, depending on how far you are through the path. Otherwise you can very easily and quickly die. Quickly make your way to whichever hanging vine is available to you, and click it in order to return to the surface of the maze.
* Head all the way east until you reach a small cave with a chest. Pray melee when you fall down until passing through the metal door 3.
* Enter the small cave and pick the lock on the chest. Search the chest and you will obtain a bronze key.
* Move through the Bronze Door just north-west of this chest.  If you must leave and return, you will need to obtain the bronze key again.
* Move north until checkpoint 4, pray ranged when you fall down. Note: The cave below has many dead ends. Check the map to memorize the route towards the rope (checkpoint 3).
* Move west to checkpoint 5.
* Continue reading at the #Combined part section below.

steps.title: = On the tank path: =
steps.content:
- * You will need a slash weapon in order to cut webs, as well as a pickaxe to mine rocks blocking your path. It is not possible to fail slashing a web if that web is on the correct path.
* Pray ranged all the way until checkpoint 5. You will be attacked by both melee and ranged, but due to distance, melee attacks are less frequent.
* There are several spots where you will stand between climbable rocks and a web. These can be treated as safespots if you ever need to take a rest.
* If you run into a rock or a web which you're unable to break or cut through, and you get a game message in chat containing something like '...Maybe find another route.', you will have to try another route.
* Make your way east until you find a crossroads going south or north.
** It is recommended players try the southern route first. If the web cannot be slashed, the player must move to the northern path.
*** After successfully slashing the web and walking through, right-click to unlock one of the chests; if it opens, search it for a combat scratched key, and if it doesn't, unlock and search the other chest.
*** Continue east and then north until the two paths meet up again.
** If the southern web is not slashable, go back up the rocks and head north. This path will lead to another room with similar chests.
*** Right-click to unlock one of the chests; if it opens, search it for a combat damaged key, and if it doesn't, unlock and search the other chest.
*** Continue through to the north-east to meet up with the other path.
* After meeting up with the alternative route, continue further north and pass through the door matching the key you obtained (see the map for each door's location).
* You will now pass some traps. The traps that are on the 'correct' route for the player (as indicated by their key) can be disarmed by the player, and will shoot darts significantly less. The traps on the wrong route will always fire when passing them.
** The floor blade trap can be avoided with proper timing, but getting hit by them will hit relatively low damage compared to the damage done by the monkeys.
** Do not bother disarming the dart traps, as these only seem to fire if the player takes the wrong route, or stands still in their line of sight for several seconds. If these do shoot you, they may inflict poison starting at 8 damage.
** The spinning blade can be disarmed, or you can simply run past taking a small amount of damage. However, do NOT run past if you do not have the "combat scratched key", since that will cause you to get stuck, forcing you to teleport out.
* Open the door for your key as indicated on the map, and continue west to meet up with the agility route.

steps.title: = Combined part =
steps.content:
- *For this part, pray melee if you fall down, and keep your prayer on after climbing up the rope to protect from the three monkeys walking around above.
*Follow the path that doesn't give a message that this route feels wrong.
*'''Before you cross the dodgy ground into Kruk's room, investigate the wall that faces the path you did not take (i.e. the western wall if you take the eastern path)'''.
**Should you wish to restock, or should you wish to return after you die, you can use this shortcut by entering the hole just east of the very start of the dungeon.
*After unlocking this shortcut, enter the large cave south of the dodgy ground, to encounter Kruk.

steps.title: Chapter III
steps.content: Items required: ''20 coins, m'speak amulet, Kruk greegree, weapon and armour. Recommended: chisel, hammer, Ape Atoll teleport, Trollheim teleport, ring of dueling, food, 1-2 prayer potions (if melee), 1-2 stamina potions.''

steps.title: ='Convincing' the leaders=
steps.content:
- *Teleport to Trollheim using standard spellbook teleport or stony basalt and enter the Troll Stronghold.
*Go south-west of the entrance into the room with Kob.
*Activate Protect from Melee and talk to Kob.  Fight him until he gives up.
**Like Kob, Keef can hit through protection prayers, and Keef will also despawn if the fight takes too long.
**There is a tree that can be used as a safespot, by trapping Keef to the north of the tree.
*You may now want to bank your heavy armour and weapons and withdraw your graceful outfit and some stamina potions, as there is no more combat involved in the next section.
*Go back to Ape Atoll and talk to Garkor near Awowogei.
*Find Assistant Le Smith and talk to him , who is found somewhere on the rooftops of Marim. There are four possible locations:
** Top floor (up two ladders) of the broken building next to the Monkey Child and The Monkey's Aunt.
** Top floor of the jail. To access the top floor, climb the ladder by Solihib's Food Stall, then walk northwards and climb the ladder north of the bamboo bed.
** Top floor of the building west of the Magic Stall. To access this building, climb the ladder at the southern end of the Temple of Marimbo. Then, climb the ladder on the north-west corner of the building, then run all the way south-west to reach the aforementioned building.
*** Alternatively, go to the building east of the magic stall and search the south-east crate to enter a cave. Go to the west end of the cave and climb up the rope. Warning: You will take heavy damage (30+) from falling in to the dungeon, which can kill you if your Hitpoints are low.
** On top of the bridge that connects the two watchtowers of the main gate.
*Talk to Garkor.
*Go to the west side of the island and talk to the monkey guard  next to a boat to go to the airship platform.
}}

steps.title: =The airship platforms=
steps.content:
thumb|300px|A labelled map of the airship platform. The green ladder on the first floor can go up or down.
- *Navigate your way through the maze without being caught by the ninja monkeys. You will need to pick up 6 satchels, fill them with explosives, then use them in 6 different locations. Any explosives that have already been placed will remain even if caught.
**Make your way to the east wall of the ground floor. Move past the (cyan) ladder on the north side and climb the (green) ladder in the east.
**Go south then west and climb down the (blue) ladder. Navigate to the end and pick up 6 satchels from the crates.
**Go back to the first (cyan) ladder of the ground floor on the north wall and climb it.
**Climb down the next (magenta) ladder you find. Follow the path north to reach the explosives.
**Click the barrel to fill all 6 satchels. If you get caught from this point on, you will need to come back here to fill your satchels again.
**Climb back up the (magenta) ladder and go south. Use a satchel on the weakened floorboards.
**Go back to the ground floor using the (cyan) ladder on the north wall.
**Go south and place a satchel on the support beams to the east.
**Take the (green) ladder on the east side of the ground floor.
**Take the west path, cross the vines, then take the north route at the fork to the end. Place a satchel on the weakened floorboards there.
**Go back to the (green) ladder on the middle floor and climb up to the top floor. Go south and place a satchel on the gas cylinder.
**Go north and place another satchel on the gas cylinder there.
**Make your way to the ground floor and go back towards the boat. Place a satchel on the support beams found in the west fork near the entrance.
*Go back to the boat, you can get caught to make it faster.
*Talk to Garkor.
*Enter the trapdoor to the dungeon you fought Kruk in.
*Go north to find monkey bars. Equip your Kruk greegree and use the monkey bars.
*Enter the passage into Glough's laboratory.
*Climb on the stunted demonic gorilla and go down the stairs.
*Fight the three gorillas until they return to their cages. Use Protect from Melee if necessary.
*Use Holding area to dismount the stunted demonic gorilla.
*Search the crates for a chisel and hammer if needed.
*Go upstairs and tamper with the device to the north.
*Use the chisel on the charged onyx, then use the deconstructed onyx on the device.
*Investigate an incubation chamber.
*Talk to Garkor.
*Talk to Awowogei.
*Talk to Garkor again.

steps.title: Crisis

*Return to Hamal the Chieftain. 
}}

steps.title: Poisoning the food supply
steps.content:
Items needed:  barrel of naphtha, mourner gear, teleport crystal, rotten apple (optional: necklace of passage, Ardougne teleport, & a teleport out)
- *Talk to the head mourner, Essyllt.
*Take the rotten apple, located north-west of the Mourner Headquarters by squeezing through the gap in the western fence.
*Talk to Elena west of Ardougne log balance shortcut, you'll be given a sieve.
*Go to the apple orchard to the north-west, west of the Combat Training Camp. North-east of The Outpost using a necklace of passage.
*Pick up an empty barrel inside the orchard and use it on one of the Rotten Apple Piles.
*Use your barrel of rotten apples on the apple press (slightly west of the rotten apple piles) to mash them.
*Use your barrel of naphtha on your mushed apple barrel (in your inventory); then, use your sieve on it.
**See the full guide if you do not have a barrel of naphtha.
*Use the toxic naphtha on a range, not a fire. Make sure you have two open inventory spaces to receive both toxic powders.
**There is a range in the mourner HQ that you can use to save time.
*Add the toxic powder to grain sacks to poison any 2 of the food stores in West Ardougne. The closest 2 are:
**The western room of the main building north of the town square.
**The church south of the town square.
*Talk to Essyllt.
*Talk to Arianwyn in Lletya.
*Congratulations, quest complete!
*Mourning's End Part II (Quick guide)

steps.title: Entering the temple
steps.content:
275px|right|thumb|Map of the area and path to the blackened crystal.
- *Talk to Arianwyn in Lletya.
*(optional) Note to Ironmen:  if you do not have a death talisman, search the bookshelves for a book titled Prifddinas' history. You might need it later as part of the 50 items and this will allow you to potentially save time and a charge on your teleport.

steps.content:
- *If you do not have a death talisman/tiara or catalytic talisman/tiara, refer to the full guide to get the 50 required items.
**Returning to Thorgel: go up the eastern stairs, then south and up the ladder to the top floor to return to Thorgel. Climb the stairs down to the altar twice.

steps.title: Getting the goutweed

Items needed:  Three buckets of Ugthanki dung, seven buckets of supercompost (or 7 supercompost stored in the Tool Leprechaun), a spade, climbing boots, empty bucket (no need to bring one, there is one south of the Death Plateau cooking pot), at least one free inventory slot.

steps.content:

steps.title: Starting out
steps.content:
- *Talk to Drezel to get three meat pies and three apple pies. . Note that Filliman will disappear after a while so you need to be actively interacting with him.
*Take the washing bowl off the nearby bench to find a mirror underneath.
*Use the mirror on Filliman, he then tells you to find his journal. If using does not work, try talking him again, it should do the trick.
*Search (right-click) the grotto tree to get his journal then use it on him to give it to him.  He'll give you a druidic spell.}}

steps.title: The Nature Spirit
steps.content:
- *Run back to Drezel and ask him to bless you.
**UIM Note: If you discarded your Wolfbane, you will first have to take the replacement dagger and then speak to him to be blessed.
*Enter the swamp, stand next to a rotting log in the swamp and cast the druidic spell.
*Quickly pick a mushroom growing from the log and bring it back to Filliman's camp.
* Talk to Filliman to ensure he is standing outside between all 3 stones.
*Use the mushroom on the light-brown stone.
*Use the used spell card on the grey stone.
*Stand on the orange stone and tell Filliman you've solved the puzzle.

steps.title: Killing the Ghasts
steps.content:
- *Leave the grotto and stand next to rotting plants (logs, bushes, branches) in the swamp.
*Using the silver sickle (b)'s Bloom ability (requires prayer points), harvest the swamp plants and fill your druid pouch with them.
*Use your filled druid pouch on Ghasts to make them attackable, kill three of them.
*Return to the nature spirit by clicking the grotto in the cave and he'll redecorate the grotto.
**If you plan on completing the Morytania Diary, pray at the altar now.
*Congratulations, quest complete!

steps.title: Agreeing to the favours

- *Talk to Yanni Salika in Shilo Village (north of the bridge at the quest icon). 
*Travel tip: Use the minigames teleport to Pest Control, then leave by talking to the Squire to the north and you'll be at Port Sarim. Or you Can use the Rat Pits teleport to Port Sarim, if you have completed Rat Catchers.
*Talk to Brian in the Port Sarim axe shop. 
*Talk to Aggie in Draynor Village. 
*Talk to Johanhus Ulsbrecht near the prison inside of the H.A.M. Hideout. 
*Talk to Fred the Farmer NE of the H.A.M. Hideout at the Sheep Shearer quest start point.  (4 if you haven't done Sheep Shearer)
*Prepare a bowl of hot water and take a pot in the Lumbridge Castle kitchen if needed. Gather 3 steel bars if not already carrying.
*Talk to Seth Groats in the chicken farm east of River Lum.  
*Talk to Horvik at the armour shop in Varrock. Give him 3 steel bars. 
*Talk to the Apothecary in Varrock south of the western bank. 
*Travel tip: amulet of glory to Edgeville, run south or use a skull sceptre.
*Talk to Tassie Slipcast in the Barbarian Village at the pottery icon on the minimap.

*''Pick up the cup of tea from the house north of Sanfew, then drink the tea to obtain an empty cup, if you haven't got one already.''
*Talk to Sanfew on the top floor of the Taverley herblore shop about initiates.  (2-2-3-1 if you have completed Eadgar's Ruse)
*Add your bowl of hot water to a teacup. Add a harralander, 2 guam leaves, and a marrentill. The empty bowl can be dropped afterwards.
*Travel tip: Ring of dueling to Al Kharid, then use the gnome glider to White Wolf Mountain.
*Talk to Captain Bleemadge on top of White Wolf Mountain at the gnome glider icon on the minimap. 
*Talk to Arhein on the Catherby docks south of the bank. 
*Talk to Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight in the building north of the Seers' chapel.

*Talk to Rantz in the eastern Feldip Hills at the quest icon on the minimap.

Perilous Moons.enemies:
* Sulphur Nagua (level 98)
* Blue Moon (level 329)
* Blood Moon (level 329)
* Eclipse Moon (level 329)

steps.content:
- * Speak to Attala near the temple entrance at the southern base of Ralos' Rise to start the quest.
* Climb the rocks to the north-east (requires 47 agility) or walk back up Ralos' Rise and kill the Sulphur Nagua at the south-east ledge.
* Return to Attala.  Cross the drawbridge and enter Cam Torum.
* Go directly north and attempt to speak with Jessamine.  A guard will interrupt you.  Speak with Jessamine in the northern part of the city.

- * Take from the crate of building supplies just west of Jessamine.  You will receive a hammer, saw, and three Building supplies.
* You will need to build the three camp sites by going through the various entrances in the corners of the dungeon.  Note that camp spots are marked on your mini map as a cooking range icon:
** Ancient Prison
*** Pass through the south-western entrance in the dungeon
*** Be aware of the level 98 Sulphur Nagua in this area.  Protect from Melee will negate damage.
*** Run south, then west, then north through the large hallway to the north-west corner
*** Build the camp spot and return back to the Antechamber. You will need to go back the way you came in.
** Streambound Cavern
*** Pass through the north-eastern entrance in the dungeon
*** Go north, then east across the bridge.  Follow the trail up the south stairs.  The camp spot is just south of the stairs.
*** Build the camp spot and return back to the Antechamber.  You will need to go back the way you came in.
** Earthbound Cavern
*** Pass through the north-western entrance in the dungeon
*** Follow the trail west then south down the stairs.
*** Build the camp spot and return back to the Antechamber.  You can now drop the hammer and saw.

- * Speak to Attala in the Antechamber .
* Go north-east to the furnace and speak to the blacksmith .
* Return to Attala in the Neypotzli to the north.
* Use the two infused talismans to locate Eyatlalli.  The direction in which the earth and water talismans point—north/south or east/west—is different for each player. You may need to enter one of the chambers in the 4 corners. You may also need to enter the ancient shrine, which is accessible through either the streambound cavern or the ancient prison.   Keep using the talisman until Eyatlalli appears. Like hot/cold clues.
** This location varies from player to player
* Return to the Antechamber and attempt to speak to any of the three.  Eyatlalli will appear again.  After the dialogue ends, speak with Eyatlalli again.
}}

- * Go to the Streambound Cavern to the north-east.  Follow the path to the camp spot.
* Optionally, grab supplies from the Supply crate or make a cup of tea to restore run energy at the Cooking stove.
* Collect from a Grubby sapling to the east of the camp spot.  Use the Moonlight grub on a Pestle and mortar to receive a Moonlight grub paste
* Go to the river south-east of the camp spot, and fish the fishing spot up the stairs on the bridge to catch a Raw bream. Use a knife on the bream to receive Bream scales.
* Walk north down the stairs, and enter the small entrance.
* Walk west to reach some rocks that you can trap.  Click on 2 separate rocks to set a trap and then Rustle a bush to trap a moss lizard. 
* Pick up the Raw moss lizard.  Use a knife on the lizard to receive a Moss lizard tail.
* Exit the Earthbound Cavern to return to the Antechamber. 
* Speak to Eyatlalli with the three items to begin the ritual.

- * Prepare to battle three Moons of Peril located in the three chambers of the dungeon.  The south-eastern entrance is inaccessible.
* During the boss fights, you will need to stand in the highlighted circle to safely deal damage to the boss.  The highlighted circle occasionally changes in a clockwise direction.
* When the highlighted circle reaches the full and empty moon circles, the boss will use one of their unique special attacks.
* Each boss has a melee attack style that they are weak to.  However, high level players may not find this to be an issue.  The Moons have very high magic and range defence and are immune to poison and venom.  Damage cannot be negated with protection prayers.
* Damage dealt during a special attack phase counts towards the overall boss damage.
* After a boss fight ends, you will be teleported to a camp in another chamber so you can quickly move onto the next encounter.
** The Blue Moon
*** Note: This boss is weak to crush
*** Enter the north-western chamber and follow the trail past the camp spot.  Go east past the camp spot until you reach another entrance to enter the boss encounter.
*** The Blue Moon uses two special attacks:
**** Weapon freeze - The Moon unequips your weapon and puts it in a block of ice. Punch the ice to deal damage to release it. The Moon will periodically spawn ice spikes on the floor around the block of ice which must be avoided by stepping off of them.
**** Brazier - The Moon extinguishes the two braziers at the edges of the room, similar to the braziers in Wintertodt. Run to each brazier in the room and reignite it while avoiding the moving tornadoes that deal damage and turn off your run energy.
** The Blood Moon
*** Note: This boss is weak to slash
*** Enter the south-western chamber and follow the path to the boss entrance.
*** The Blood Moon uses two special attacks:
**** Raining Blood - The Moon will disappear and rain blood from above, forming pools of blood throughout the room. Move off of the blood pools on the floor to avoid standing on them.
**** Blood Jaguar - Blood jaguars spawn around the room, along with a damaging square of blood pools. Run to Eyatlalli's glyph and attack the jaguar. Damage taken by stepping onto the pool too early or not stepping out of the jaguar's attack range will heal the Blood Moon for 3x the damage taken.
** The Eclipse Moon
*** Note: This boss is weak to stab
*** Enter the north-eastern chamber and follow the path to the boss entrance.
*** The Eclipse Moon uses two special attacks:
**** Eclipse Shield - The Moon will spawn a moon shield and begins attacking rapidly with rays of light. Keep the moon shield between you and the boss to prevent damage from the attacks. The shield will move quickly around the boss in a circle.
**** Mimic - You are teleported to the centre of the room and frozen in place. Clones of the Moon will spawn around you, attacking you. You must face your character toward each clone as it spawns to prevent damage. One method is to click the tile below each clone as it spawns.  Reacting to the clone has no delay so it is advised to use your strongest weapon (Crystal Halberd), no matter the speed.

- * After defeating the three Moons, return to the Antechamber.
* Speak to all three in the Antechamber.
* Speak to Eyatlalli to finish the quest.

*For each bone in vinegar do:
**Place a set of logs on the pot-boiler next to the old man.
**Use a bone in vinegar with the pot-boiler.
**Light the set of logs with your tinderbox.
**Wait 12 seconds until the fire is consumed and remove the pot from the pot-boiler. (Alternatively, hop worlds after lighting the logs for them to be finished when you log back in)
*Talk to the Odd Old Man.
*Congratulations, quest complete!

steps.title: Polishing the bones
steps.content:
- *Talk to Fortunato located in Draynor marketplace and buy 27 jug of vinegar.
*Use all of the jugs of vinegar with all the pots to make 27 pots of vinegar.
*Use all of the bones with your pots of vinegar to get 27 bones in vinegar.
*Withdraw a tinderbox and either logs or an axe. Each bones in vinegar will require 1 set of logs. There are trees nearby that can be cut for logs.
*Return back to the Odd Old Man and talk to him.
*For each bone in vinegar do the following:
**Place a set of logs on the pot-boiler next to the old man.
**Use a bone in vinegar with the pot-boiler.
**Light the set of logs with your tinderbox.
**Wait 12 seconds until the fire is consumed and remove the pot from the pot-boiler. (Alternatively, hop worlds after lighting the logs for them to be finished when you log back in)
*Talk to the Odd Old Man.
*Congratulations, quest complete!

*While waiting to clean bones, players may examine skeletons surrounding the Odd Old Man's house. One such skeleton states "What a waste of prayer xp!".
*Rag and Bone Man II was formerly a miniquest named "Rag & Bone Wish List". As miniquests do not usually give quest points, it was renamed Rag and Bone Man II and reclassified as a quest in an update on 17 August 2017.

steps.title: The final battles
steps.content:
- *You will need 175 Quest Points and complete Desert Treasure I and Horror from the Deep before entering the portal.
*Remember, you can bank between every kill. Enter the portal and defeat without prayers:
**Agrith-Na-Na – Range or melee it, wear dragonhide.
**Flambeed – Mage him with water spells + snare. He can unequip your weapon, unless you are wearing ice gloves.
**Karamel – Run into melee distance and use fire spells. Ranged and melee work as well, but are less accurate. She will lower your stats frequently. Bring at least 2 restore potions. If going melee, use super combat potions
**Dessourt – Mage (air spells or Iban blast) or range him. Snare will help.
**Gelatinnoth Mother – Bring runes for all 4 elemental spells, a melee weapon, and a ranged weapon. Aim for high range defence without sacrificing too much magic attack.
**Culinaromancer – Attack with whatever you can hit hardest with. Most of his damage comes from a magic attack that hits at a flat 1-in-3 rate, so your magic defence is irrelevant.
*Congratulations, quest complete!

* Fast travel to the Underground Pass (West Ardougne teleport or travel from East Ardougne)
* OPTIONAL: Your Iban's staff or its upgraded counterpart in order to recharge it for free by using it on the well during the Underground Pass section

steps.title: Back through the Underground Pass
steps.content: - *Talk to King Lathas in Ardougne Castle.

steps.title: Traversing Isafdar
steps.content:
thumb|400px|A detailed map of Tirannwn.
- *Run west through the forest, then talk to Idris when he spawns (this may take a little while).
*Follow the map to Lord Iorwerth.
**Run south-west, jump the leaves trap (click the middle square closest to you).
**Run west, pass through the sticks trap. (For this stick trap, and any stick traps you may encounter during this quest, simply stand one square in front of the trap and spam-click the trap until your character moves over it. This will negate all damage from the trap.)
**Follow the path north-west, jump the leaves trap, and continue north until you reach the Iorwerth Camp. Cross the Log Balance to reach it.
*Talk to Lord Iorwerth.
*Follow the map to the Elf Tracker.
** Run back the way you came and run south-east once you reach the Sticks trap (do not go through the sticks trap).
*Talk to the Elf Tracker.
*Talk to Lord Iorwerth again. (You must have an open space in your inventory to receive the Crystal Pendant.)
*Talk to the Elf Tracker again.
*Click to follow the tracks, they are west of the tracker, at the north-west corner of the blue mushrooms.
*Talk to the Elf Tracker.
*Climb through the dense forest, kill the Level 110 Tyras Guard that immediately spawns.
**The guard can be safespotted by the mushrooms to the south-west.
*Go north, pass tripwire and go through more dense forest.
*Run west then south through more dense forest, talk to General Hining in the camp.
*Take at least 2 barrels. 3 is highly recommended in case you fail distillation of coal tar in upcoming steps. The second barrel is needed for Mourning's End Part I.
*Go back to the Elf Tracker and use 2-3 of your barrels on the tar just south of him to obtain barrel of coal tar.
*Get a piece of sulphur from right next to where you got the tar.
*Talk to Lord Iorwerth with one empty inventory slot. Players wishing to keep their Crystal pendant should drop it each time before talking to Lord Iorwerth (or King Lathas) for the rest of the quest. Banking it will not keep it safe! 
*Read the book and keep it in your inventory. 
*Talk to Lord Iorwerth about each item (sulphur, naptha, quicklime, barrel, and fuse).

steps.title: Preparing the bomb
steps.content:
- *Use limestone on any furnace (make sure gloves are equipped or you will take damage.)
*With a pot in your inventory, use your pestle and mortar on the quicklime. If you do this incorrectly, you will need to repeat the previous step with a new limestone.
*Use your pestle and mortar on the sulphur.
*If you have not already created a strip of cloth, use four balls of wool on the loom in the farm south of Falador or near the house portal in the Hosidius area to make one.

steps.title: Deadly chemistry
steps.content:
- *The coal from your bank can be noted, but you will need to un-note it using Phials in the nearby general store once you get there.
*Talk to the chemist

steps.title: Royal assassination
steps.content:
- *Go through the Underground Pass
once more. Bringing summer pies this time is highly recommended because you are now carrying a very heavy barrel bomb.
*If you did not bring your own cooked rabbit, kill one north-west of the Elf Tracker and cook it. If you forgot an axe, there is a fire in the Iorwerth Camp.
*Head to the catapult, north of the Tyras Camp.
*If you did not bring a tinderbox, go south to Quartermaster's general store and purchase a tinderbox before you give the guard near the catapult the cooked rabbit.
*Use the cooked rabbit on the guard near the catapult. 
*Use the bomb on the catapult. 
*Talk to Lord Iorwerth.

steps.title: Lord Iorwerth's message
steps.content:
- *Attempt to enter Ardougne Castle.
*Talk to King Lathas.
*Congratulations, quest complete!
*Roving Elves

*Talk to the Apothecary south of Varrock west bank.  ( If you have done Ratcatchers,  If you have done A Tail of Two Cats.)
*Give the potion to Juliet.
*Go back to Romeo and tell him to meet Juliet in the crypt.
*Congratulations, quest complete!}}

steps.title: Tracking Islwyn
steps.content:
thumb|350x350px

- *Head to Tirannwn (Catherby teleport (tablet), use charter to Port Tyras)
*Track down Islwyn, who will be either west of Lletya or north-east of the Tyras Camp. Use this map to assist you. (If the elves are not there, switch worlds until they appear)
*Offer your help to Islwyn.

steps.title: Obtaining the Seed
steps.content:
- *Bank all your combat equipment, runes included.
**Go to Tree Gnome Village dungeon and retrieve Glarial's pebble if you didn't save one from Waterfall Quest.
*Travel north-west of the Fishing Guild and use Glarial's pebble on Glarial's tombstone.
*Kill a Moss Guardian (level 84). It will drop a consecration seed.
*Take the seed to Eluned.

steps.title: Planting The Seed
steps.content:
- *Enter the Waterfall Dungeon.
**Board the log raft north of Baxtorian Falls.
**Use a rope on the rock.
**Use a rope on the dead tree.
**Open the door to enter.
*(Skip this step if you already have the key.) Search the most northern crates in the east room for a key.
*Take the west path all the way north.
*Left click the seed in the final room to plant it.
*Return to Islwyn to choose your reward.
*Congratulations, quest complete!
**Optional: Speak to Eluned to start Mourning's End Part I, which will allow you to receive the teleport crystal to Lletya.
*Mourning's End Part I

Also take 5 coal or have at least 5 empty spaces. Note: Do not waste time trying to mine coal near Miner Magnus, as you don't actually get any resources. An area to mine coal is provided later on in the quest.}}

steps.title: The dungeon
steps.content:
- *Talk to King Vargas.
*Talk to Advisor Ghrim. 
*Talk to King Vargas with one open inventory slot to receive a scroll proving you are Regent of Miscellania.
*Enter the dungeon, down the ladder in the courtyard (along the castle's south wall).
*Talk to Donal in the pub. 
*Go north, take a pick (on the rock next to the dwarves) if you need coal.
*Use the mining prop on the crevice and proceed through the crevice.
*Take an engine and put the 5 coal in it.
*Take the following from the crates:
**2 beams.
**3 pulley beams.
**1 rope.
*Use a beam on a pulley beam to get a long pulley beam; use another regular beam on it to make a longer pulley beam.
*To the broken scaffold add:
**A pulley beam.
**A longer pulley beam.
**A pulley beam.
**A rope.
*Take:
**1 beam.
**1 rope.
*Add a beam to the platform.
*Put the engine on the engine platform.
*If you haven't yet, add your five coal to the engine.
*Use the lift and take the plank.
*Enter the tunnel, run east, and use your rope on the rock.
**Keep running and make sure to continue through your character's dialogue.
*Take the diary from the fire remains.
*Use your plank to cross the rocks, be sure to collect all diary pages by searching the four additional fires through the cave.
*Continue running and avoid the steam vents as they will damage you.
*Read the diary and continue through the crevice, watch the cutscene.
*Talk to Armod.
}}

steps.title: Starting out
steps.content:
- *Take a rake and a seed dibber from the leprechaun if you haven't got one already.
*Talk to Pirate Pete on the dock north-east of the Ectofuntus, decline the money.

steps.title: Blindweed
steps.content:
- *If you still do not have a rake and a seed dibber, go down the ladder in the north-west corner. Head south-east past the spiders, and search the cupboard there for the tools. Go back upstairs.
*Leave the building to the south, down the stairs.
*Go south past the zombies and plant the blindweed in the south-eastern-most patch.
*Wait about 5 minutes (or a few seconds) for it to grow. (Warning: Nearby Zombie swabs can attack low and mid-levelled players. You can simply log out while waiting.) You'll receive an in-game message when it finishes growing. Pick the plant.
*Talk to Captain Braindeath.
*Climb-up the ladder in the south-east corner of the big room.
*Put the blindweed in the hopper (next to the pressure barrel) in the north-west corner of the room.

steps.title: Stagnant water
steps.content:
- *Talk to Captain Braindeath. You will automatically get a bucket in your inventory if you don't have one.
*Leave the building using the stairs to the south, head west to the bridge, and open the gate north of 50% Luke.
*Head north to the water source on the map, and fill the bucket with stagnant water.
*Return to the brewery and add the stagnant water to the hopper. (Ectophial and talking to Pirate Pete is faster than walking back.)

steps.title: Sluglings
steps.content:
- *Talk to Captain Braindeath.
*Fish 5 sluglings.  Fishing spots can be found east, south-east, and west of the farming patch. (Note: do not untangle the Fishbowl and net, if you do then use one on the other to retangle.)
*Put the sluglings in the pressure barrel by the hopper.
*Pull the lever.

steps.title: The evil spirit
steps.content:
- *Talk to Captain Braindeath.
*Talk to Davey in the room to the west, with all the bunk beds. (Note: He will only bless the wrench if you have 47 or more Prayer points)
*Use the holy wrench on the shaking brewing control.
*Kill the level 150 Evil spirit. (Can be safespotted)

steps.title: The spider carcass
steps.content:
- *Talk to Captain Braindeath. (Complete the dialogue or the fever spider corpse won't drop)
*Climb down the nearby ladder.
*Kill a fever spider (can be safespotted by standing north-west of the ladder) 
* Put its body in the hopper on the top floor.

steps.title: Finishing up
steps.content:
- *Talk to Captain Braindeath.
*Collect some 'Unsanitary Swill' from the output tap (south end of the brewing machine) using the bucket used for the stagnant water. (if you dropped the first one, he will give you a second one here)
*Give it to Captain Donnie outside, amongst the protesters.
*Talk to Captain Braindeath.
*Congratulations, quest complete!
