steps.title: Getting started
First scorpion
steps.content:
- *Note: You will need a dusty key if you don't have 70 Agility, make sure to grab it before entering the dungeon.
*Go into Taverley Dungeon, (South Taverley) and go to the poison spider area.
**If you need a dusty key head south to the Black Knights' Base and kill the jailer. Use the key on the jail cell and talk to Velrak the explorer. He will give you the key. Alternatively, a dusty key spawns deep in Taverley Dungeon, near the lava eel fishing spot south of the blue dragon area.
*Directly south of the level 80 Agility shortcut, search the old wall to enter a small room.
*Use the scorpion cage on the Kharid Scorpion. If you try to pick it up, it will sting you instead.

steps.title: Second scorpion
steps.content:
- *Go to the Barbarian Outpost (a games necklace is helpful).
*Go inside the fenced in area near the entrance to the agility course.
*Go inside the building in the north-east corner of the area.
*Use the scorpion cage on the Kharid Scorpion. If you try to pick it up, it will sting you instead.
**Note: It is possible for the scorpion to be outside of the small room, in the Agility area, if someone has let it out.

steps.title: Third scorpion
steps.content:
- *Go to the Monastery between Edgeville and Ice Mountain (a combat bracelet will take you right there).
*Climb the eastern ladder and go to the east side of the floor.
**Note: If the Monk stops you and says only members of the order may go upstairs, simply say that you want to join and you will be allowed to go upstairs.
*Use the scorpion cage on the Kharid Scorpion. If you try to pick it up, it will sting you instead.

steps.title: Finishing Up
steps.content:
- *Return the full scorpion cage to Thormac.
*Congratulations, quest complete!

steps.content:
- * Talk to Alan, Tal Teok Temple north of Tal Teklan 
* Inspect the egg
* Talk to King, the bartender in The King's Inn west of the bank. 
* Talk to Acatzin in the inn 
** Talk to the blacksmith, west of the inn.
** Repair the whetstone with a hammer; one spawns in the building. Keep it!
** Talk to the blacksmith again for Acatzin's axe, then repair it on the whetstone.
** Return to Acatzin. Take a bowl from the table before you leave.
* Fill the bowl with water at the fountain outside.
* Talk to Nezketi at the temple directly south of the inn for an empty cup. 
** Pick damiana leaves from the damiana directly outside of the south-eastern walls of Tal Teklan.
** While you are there, head a bit further south-west and pick up the two planks.
** Add the damiana leaves to the bowl of water.
** Head to the Tal Teklan General Store just south of the bank.
** Use the bowl on the oven to boil the damiana water.
** Use the bowl on the empty cup, then return to Nezketi with the damiana tea.
* Talk to Kauayotl, outside the eastern entrance of Tal Teklan. 
** Return to the blacksmith; pick up the hammer if you dropped it.
** Search his workbench for 20 iron nails.
** Pick up a saw at Arcuani's Archery Supplies just south of the blacksmith.
** Repair the racing cart next to Kauayotl. 
** Talk to Kauayotl again.
* Return to Tal Teok Temple and speak to any of King's men.
* Large egg:
** Search the eggs at the chicken farm directly south.
** Defeat the large chicken and search the eggs again.
* Dragon egg:
** Head to the bank for some combat equipment and dragonfire protection.
** Enter the cave entrance to the Dragon Nest to the east (marked on the world map as link=)
** Search the eggs in the south-east corner of the nest. Defeat the red dragon, who can be safespotted by using the eggs.
** Search the eggs again and head back outside.
* Jaguar egg:
** From the Dragon Nest, run eastwards until you reach a campsite.
** Search the eggs and defeat the black jaguar; it has routefinding capabilities, however it can be safespotted if you stand directly west of the Tropical tree closest to the river (RuneLite's Quest Helper will mark this square for you).
** Search the eggs again and return to Tal Teok.
* Speak to each of King's men to initiate a cutscene.
* Put the egg together - players can hover over the puzzle piece icon to view the solution. When a piece is rotated in the correct orientation and placed in the correct location, it will stay in place indicating the correct placement.
* Watch the final cutscene.
}}

Congratulations, quest complete!

steps.title: In the North
steps.content:
- * Head to the northern entrance of Weiss and speak to Big Fish.
* Head to the main building and speak to Snowflake. 
* Head down the stairs in the main building, and go through the southern cave entrance. 
* After the cutscene, fight the assassin. He will attack with melee or ranged, whichever style the player is not praying protection against.
** The assassin will continually throw 1x1 tile smoke bombs around the room, which you then need to lure him inside to be able to deal damage.
** The assassin will also occasionally throw vials of poison, which can deal up to 30 poison damage and inflict poison starting at 6 damage.
* Talk to Hazeel located just south-west at the cave's entrance.
* Search the barrel south of the centre room to find a lever handle.
* Enter the centre room, using the code BLOOD to unlock the gate.
* Open the northern chest using code 7402 to obtain an icy chest.
* Light the braziers in the following order: NW, SE, NE, SW (a tinderbox can be found by searching the crate in the room)
* Open the western chest to find a jewel shard and a settlements note.
* Head to the northern room, pressing the LEFT - UP - LEFT - DOWN arrows in that order to unlock the gate.
* Use the handle on the lever mechanism, and pull it.
* Inspect the south-western pillar in the room where you fought the assassin for the other jewel shard.
* Use the jewel shards on one another, and use the ancient jewel on the icy chest.
* Open the gate south of the centre room with the icy key.
}}

steps.title: A Bloody Show
steps.content:
- {{Instance|irs=Veliaf Hurtz|cost=50000
*Go back to the Icyene Graveyard.
*Talk to Vanescula Drakan.
*Run north-east of the graveyard.
*Talk to Safalaan Hallow.
*Kill Vanstrom Klause, use Protect from Magic.
**Vanstrom uses three special attacks. He will use a special attack every 8-10 attacks, and will never use the same one twice in a row.  He can also use an attack that lowers your Attack level similar to Shadow Spells.
*** - Acidic Bloodveld is spawned and will explode on the player for high damage. Kill with ranged.
*** - A blood orb spawns that periodically heals Vanstrom. Walking on top of it (3x3 area) damages the player, but Vanstrom can be lured on top to damage him.
*** - Heavy damage is taken if the player is facing Vanstrom. The attack gives very little warning and is near impossible to avoid on reaction. It is recommended that the player keep a count of how many attacks Vanstrom has done and turn around preemptively. 
**After you deplete his hitpoints, he will heal himself 200 hitpoints and stop using his special attacks.
***Turn off protection prayers to save on prayer points as they no longer have any effect, but continue using Piety or other buffing prayers.
***Vanstrom summons lightning to strike tiles with a max hit of 46. Tiles that are about to be struck will have a dark circle on them and should be avoided.
***Consider turning off RuneLite's 117 HD plugin if enabled, as it makes it much harder to see where the lightning will strike.
**Note: You can speak to Veliaf if you wish to re-attempt the fight.
*Watch the cutscene.
*Congratulations, quest complete!

steps.title: Make-A-Sword
steps.content:
thumb|300px|An overview of the features in the Giants' Foundry.
- * Speak to Kovac to learn how to select the moulds (in red text).
* Select the fitting mould Kovac described for the forte, blade and tip at the mould jig.
* Speak to Kovac again. He will tell you to pour the metal.
* Pour the metal from the crucible into the mould.
* Get a bucket of water (grab a bucket from the pile of buckets and use it on the waterfall), and pour it on the sword. You can also use ice gloves for this step. Your hands must be free to pick up the preform.
* Heat the preform to maximum by using it on the lava pool.  The "Heat-preform" option will increase the heat by small increments, while the "Dunk-preform" option will heat it faster. The temperature should be red.
* Hit the preform with the Trip Hammer repaired earlier, repeating until progress bar is onto the yellow section. Be sure to keep the temperature in the red while doing this, otherwise the quality of the sword will decrease. Using the Trip Hammer will cool the preform.
* Cool the preform using the waterfall until its temperature is almost green. The "Cool-preform" option will cool the preform slowly, while the "Quench-preform" option cools is more quickly.
* Use the preform on Grindstone repaired earlier, repeating until progress is onto green section. Be sure to watch the temperature as the Grindstone will heat the preform during use.
* Cool the preform in the waterfall until its temperature is high green.
* Use the preform on the Polishing Wheel, repeating until the sword is complete. The Polishing Wheel will cool the preform during use, so be sure to watch the temperature.
* Speak to Kovac.
*Congratulations, quest complete!

steps.title: Fighting The Fragment
steps.content:
- *After a cutscene, you will automatically enter the Temple of Light. If you are not equipped for this fight immediately teleport out, you can re-enter the Temple of Light through the Underground Pass, through the same crack that you entered the Dwarven camp with.
*Defeat the Fragment of Seren.
**Magic is the only form of combat that is effective against the Fragment.
**Protect from Range reduces most of its damage from normal attacks.
**Equipment lost on death while in the instance can be reclaimed from an elf NPC standing outside of the cave entrance for the cost of 80,000 coins. If the player dies elsewhere before reclaiming their items, their unclaimed items will be permanently lost.
**Magic attack and damage bonus should be prioritised. High-level magic equipment such as Ancestral robes, Ahrim's robes, or void knight equipment along with the trident of the swamp and Ancient Magicks blood spells are an effective combination.
**The Fragment has four special attacks that always occur in the following order, repeating until The Fragment is defeated:
***1. An orb that teleports you to The Fragment. Simply run away after being teleported to maintain a safe distance from a melee attack.
***2. The Fragment will split into multiple parts, and you must attack the correct one. The real Fragment will have crystals underneath it, and a lighter shade of aura.
***3. The Fragment will summon healing spells. Simply attack the spells once with any attack to defeat them. Fast-hitting weapons such as throwing knives or darts are excellent here. Chinchompas are a great choice as their long range makes it easier to stay out of melee range while only being 1 tick slower than knives/darts.
***4. The Fragment will teleport you to one place and freeze you there while she winds up an attack. Then, she will unleash a heavy attack that hits for 99% of your max hp. If your hitpoints are at or below 99% of your max hp, you will be killed in 1 shot. It is highly recommended to bring Saradomin brews or anglerfish to heal above 100% health prior to the attack landing to avoid being killed.
*After defeating the Fragment of Seren, Baxtorian will invite you into Prifddinas.
*Congratulations, quest complete!

steps.title: Starting
steps.content: - *Speak to Lucien in the Flying Horse Inn in the north-west corner of East Ardougne.

steps.title: The temple
steps.content:
Items required for this part: Pendant of lucien (given by Lucien when talking to him), the necessary bow listed above (yew or better), items to obtain a boots of lightness (knife or slash weapon and light source), stamina and energy potions for looting ice arrows, food. Your character must weigh -1kg or less for this part; boots of lightness reduce weight by 4.5kg.
- *Enter the temple directly south of the Ranging Guild by climbing down the ladder.
*Go west down the stairs, slash the web, and take the boots of lightness (light source and knife or slash weapon required).
*Go back upstairs, then through the north gate with the Pendant of lucien equipped.
*Cross the lava bridge wearing the boots of lightness (weight must be -1 kg or less or you will not be able to cross and take 20 damage from falling), open the Large door, and take the lever.
*Cross the lava bridge again and attach the lever to the lever-bracket on the wall a bit west of the ladder you climbed to enter the dungeon.
*Pull the lever after attaching it. You will receive the prompt: "You hear the clunking of some hidden machinery."
*Go through the south gate and follow the path.
*Search chests along the icy path to obtain ice arrows. 16 with Ava's device and 60+ Ranged is enough.
**Note: It is possible for the arrows to be in the same chest multiple times in a row.  It is therefore recommended to search the chest again right after getting an arrow loot.
**Note: You must search every chest after finding arrows to reset the chests, hopping worlds at 1 chest no longer resets them.

steps.title: Killing the Fire Warrior
steps.content:
Items required for this part: Pendant of lucien, ice arrows, a bow that can fire ice arrows (yew or better), 20 un-noted limpwurt root. Items suggested: food and armour; if necessary, the limpwurt roots can be retrieved from a bank after killing the fire warrior.
- *Go back through the north gate with the Pendant of lucien equipped.
*Continue straight north to a small room containing a lever.
*Right-click the lever and search for traps. (Requires 42 Thieving) Then pull the lever.
*Go west then north through the doors.
*A Fire Warrior of Lesarkus will spawn in the room upon attempting to enter the second door.
*Kill him with your ice arrows.
**Use protect from magic to take no damage.
*Give Winelda 20 unnoted limpwurt roots all at once. She will teleport you to the other side of the lava.
**Ultimate Ironmen should be extremely cautious if juggling items here. As soon as you hand in the limpwurt roots, Winelda will teleport you across the lava. You will NOT be able to turn around or get back to her. 
*''Optional: follow the path to its end and take the shiny key to access this dungeon from McGrubor's Wood.''
*Push the wall to the north leading to a room full of Guardians of Armadyl.
*Pick the good or evil path.

steps.title: Good path

Congratulations, quest complete!

steps.title: Help from Some Wizards
Guardians of the Rift
steps.content:
Be advised this section has arrow prompts (link=) throughout the tutorial. Follow the arrows to complete the quest.
- * Speak to each of the apprentices in no particular order.
* Speak to Wizard Persten. The Guardians of the Rift tutorial begins after this step.
* Speak to Apprentice Cordelia.
* Speak to Apprentice Felix, then take a weak cell from the table.
* Speak to Apprentice Tamara, then place the weak cell on the inactive cell tile near her.
* Speak to Apprentice Felix.
* Take a weak cell from the table, then click on the essence pile to assemble a guardian.
* Repeat the previous step for the other essence pile.
* Speak to Apprentice Tamara.
* Mine five guardian fragments from the guardian remains.
* Speak to Apprentice Felix.
* Work at the workbench to turn guardian fragments into guardian essence.
* Speak to Apprentice Tamara.
* Take an uncharged cell from the table.
* Enter the Mind Altar and click the altar.
* Speak to Apprentice Tamara.
* Click the weak cell tile, then power-up The Great Guardian.
* Speak to Apprentice Tamara.
* Repeat the process of mining five guardian fragments and turning them into guardian essence.
* Enter the Water Altar and click the altar
* Power-up The Great Guardian.
* Speak to Apprentice Tamara.
* Click on the Essence pile again to assemble another guardian. 
* Speak to Apprentice Tamara.
* Repeat the process of mining guardian fragments and turning them into guardian essence.
* Take an uncharged cell from the table and use the water portal talisman on the water guardian.
* Click the Water Altar.
* Leave the altar and speak to Apprentice Tamara.
* Place the cell you made on the cell tile.
* Speak to Apprentice Tamara.
* Power-up The Great Guardian.
* Upon completion of the tutorial, you will automatically exit and speak to Archmage Sedridor.
*Congratulations, quest complete!

steps.title: Tomb Raiding
steps.content: - * Head to Uzer Oasis and talk to Elias White. The quickest way to reach it is via fairy ring code

steps.title: Fort Invasion
steps.content:
- * Talk to Elias.
* Make your way to Trollheim. Take the path just north-west of Trollheim (towards the ice gate), then enter the Trollweiss Dungeon directly west of the ice gate. Activate Protect from Melee. 
* Follow the tunnel north until you can enter a crevasse to get to the summit of Trollweiss Mountain. Once you've exited the crevasse, run directly east and enter the cave.
* Mine the rubble within the caves to clear the path. Each pile of rubble can only be mined once from each side, so you may have to run around the cave to mine the same rubble from different directions in order to clear it.
* Mine your way to the end of the dungeon, then head up the stairs and speak to Arrav.
* Use the unlocked door in the east and search the tapestry in the room for the base plans and base key.

steps.title: Hearty Heist
steps.content:
- * Head back to Elias at the Uzer Oasis with the plans and key.
* Make your way to the entrance of Zemouregal's Base north of the Digsite and talk to Elias again.
* Enter the base and run through the dungeon until you reach the kitchen (marked by the link= icon). Enter the kitchen through the gate.
* Wear your insulated boots, then enter the sewer system via the pipe on the southern wall.
* Enter the other end of the pipe at the very end of the path.
* Head into the southern room and search the western table for some decoder strips.
* Open the chest for the code key. Read it and take note of the four-letter code.
* Head back and attempt to open the metal doors to the east. 
*Enter your code key in order on the decoder strips in the interface that pops up. 
**Each strip will be associated with a number, 0-9, and will have an order, 1-4 on the left hand side of the strip. Use the up and down arrows to enter the number, using the right arrow to enter each number once picked.
* Equip your crossbow and mith grapple, then click on the metal bars above the fire traps to climb over them.
* Attempt to take Arrav's heart to begin a cutscene, after which you'll fight him. Activate Protect from Melee to reduce his damage.
** Every three attacks, Arrav will swing his axe in the direction he's facing, dealing up to 26 damage; move adjacent or behind him and resume attacking. You can also unequip your weapon and position yourself to face Arrav whilst being behind the axe; this results in you catching the axe and dealing additional damage.
** Armoured zombies will also spawn with 10 Hitpoints each, leaving behind venom pools wherever they walk. Stepping on these will inflict venom and deal up to 4 damage every tick if not moving.
* Upon defeating Arrav, finish watching the cutscene and the ensuing dialogue afterward to complete the quest.

- *North of the exam centre at the hilltop with the blue urn, search the second bush to the east of the blue urn to find a teddy bear.
*Take the panning tray.
*Use the cup of tea on the nearby panning guide.
*Pan the water at the panning points until you find a Special cup (browse through dialogue if stopped – referred to as "Shiny Cup" in dialogue). If you need an opal continue panning until you get one.
*Steal from the workman near the panning points until you get an animal skull and specimen brush.
*Run north to the female student with blonde hair and pigtails on the north-west end of the dig and give her the "teddy" by talking to her twice.
*Run east to the student with a beard and a reddish-orange shirt and give him the Special cup by talking to him twice.

steps.title: Exams
Helping the expert
steps.content:
- *Back at the Exam Center, go in the western room and search the cupboards on the north and south walls to get a rock pick and a specimen jar, respectively.
*If you haven't already, steal a specimen brush from the Digsite workman.
*Use the trowel on the soil in either level 3 digsite until you obtain an ancient talisman. Note: This step can take several minutes depending upon luck.
*Talk to Terry Balando in the exam centre.
*Use the invitation on any Digsite workman except the one by the western winch.
*Use a rope on the western winch, then climb down. 
*Pick up one of the arcenia root in the room, search the bricks to the east, then climb back up.
*Walk north-east to the northern winch, use the rope on the winch, and climb down.
*Talk to Doug Deeping about the rocks.

steps.title: Explosives expert
steps.content:
- *Walk to the tent to the south (marked with the orange vial), unlock the chest with the Chest Key and search to obtain chemical powder.
*Use the trowel on the closed barrel to the west of the tent.
*Use a vial on the barrel to get an unidentified liquid. If dropped, it will deal 25 non-fatal damage, and destroy the vial requiring you to re-open the barrel and collect more.
*Grind the charcoal with your pestle and mortar.
**If you don't have charcoal, search the tray a few steps north.
*Return to the exam centre and use the chemical powder and the unidentified liquid on Terry Balando (Note: make sure you right-click the liquid otherwise you'll empty it).
*Mix the nitroglycerin and ammonium nitrate together to create mixed chemicals, then add ground charcoal and finally arcenia root to produce chemical compound.
*Climb down the western winch.
*Use the compound on the bricks (not the rocks).
*Use your tinderbox on the bricks.
*Enter the large chamber, take the stone tablet. Low-levels should be wary of Level 22 skeletons.

steps.title: Finishing up
steps.content:
- *Use the tablet on Terry Balando.
*Congratulations, quest complete!

steps.title: Infiltration II
steps.content:
- * Talk to Servius at the {{floor|uk=0 of the Sunrise Palace to start the quest. 
* After the cutscene, make your way to the Twilight Temple. Search the chest at the Tower of Ascension for the emissary robes if needed.
* Equip the emissary robes and enter the temple.
* After the cutscene, attempt to go downstairs and choose the passcode "Final Dawn".
* Enter the basement, and head east toward the backroom while avoiding the Emissary Enforcer.
* Enter the backroom and watch the cutscene.  
* Search the large bed (south room) for a key.
* Open the drawer in either the south or north room for the canvas piece.
* Use the canvas piece on the painting at the eastern end.
* Inspect the painting and enter a hidden passage.  
* Picklock the blue chest for an emissary scroll. To open the chest, simply move the tumblers by clicking on slots above them.
** The fastest way to brute force the lock is to simply click confirm, see if any show up as green on the right, and if not, move everything up by one. This will take no more than eight tries for the final combination.
* Fight the Emissary Enforcer (180 HP AoE melee):
** You cannot teleport, pray, or change gear. If you die here, your gravestone will appear at the Twilight Temple entrance.  
** Step back during normal attacks, and step sideways when he shouts  or   
* Pick up and read the emissary scroll.  
* Return to Queen Zyanyi at the top floor of the Sunrise Palace.
}}

steps.title: Home Invasion
steps.content:
- * Go behind the safe house south of the western bank in Civitas illa Fortis.
* Talk to Captain Vibia.
* Inspect the southernmost window on the east side of the safe house.
* Enter the window and use your chosen bones/meat on the dog.
* Pet the dog for the door's passcode, "GUS".
* Grab the sack of potatoes; empty the sack.
* Take the knife nearby.
* Head up to the middle floor and pick up the coin purse.
* Empty the purse, then head up to the top floor.
* Use the knife on the diseased off-green potted plant for a branch.
* Use the empty coin purse on the pot of sand to fill it up.
* Use the branch and sandy coin purse on each other to create the makeshift blackjack.
* Show the sack and blackjack to Captain Vibia to initiate a cutscene.
* Search Janus for a key which initiates another cutscene.
* Agree to go with Queen Zyanyi to Cam Torum.

steps.title: Dwarven Traitor
steps.content:
- * Speak to Attala in the Cam Torum market.
* Enter Teumo's house east of the bank.
* Head upstairs and pick up the beer.
* Return downstairs and use the beer on Galna.
* Enter Teumo's basement. Search the cabinet to the south-west and grab one of each of the following beverages: steamforge brew, dwarven stout, beer, and wizard's mind bomb.
* Place the steamforge brew on the barrel directly south of the cabinet (indicated with "steam")
* Place the stout directly east of this barrel (indicated with "black liquid")
* Place the beer on the northern barrel (indicated with "smells like a standard Gielinorian pub")
* Place the mind bomb on the south-eastern barrel (indicated with "bubbling")
* Drink the beer on the barrel south of the staircase (indicated with "empty"), then place the beer glass on it.
* Inspect the fireplace and pull a hidden lever.
* Climb through the hole in the wall in the south-eastern room to initiate a cutscene.
* Return to Servius and Attala in the basement and talk to them.

steps.title: Interlopers in Neypotzli
steps.content:
- * Head to the bank and prepare for a fight against two level 160 cultists.
* Head north to Neypotzli to have Eyatlalli give you a keystone fragment.
* Head through the Streambound and Earthbound Caverns, using the keystone to pinpoint the exact tile to resonate with the key.
* Head to the Ancient Prison and use it in the room to the south-east in the section.
* Touch the glowing symbol to initiate a cutscene.
* Kill Lucius and Chimalli.
** Alternate Protect from Magic/Ranged. Step into golden circles to avoid Lucius' special, and avoid Chimalli's fire arrows by stepping away from where they will land.
** Once one of them are defeated, the other will start to pierce prayer and perform special attacks more frequently.
** It is recommended to kill Lucius first, since Chimalli's special attack is much easier to avoid, especially if using melee.
* Talk to Attala.

steps.title: Crypt Assault
steps.content:
- * Head to Tal Teklan. Servius is north-east of the Quetzal Transport System landing site, east of the altar.
* The Crypt of Tonali is a fair distance to the south-east, just west of Kastori.
* Enter the Crypt of Tonali to initiate a cutscene.
* Kill six waves of cultists; allies can be healed by using food on them. If all Tonali warriors and archers helping you die, the waves reset.
* Complete all six waves successfully to initiate a cutscene. The fight will not start until after all the dialogue.
* Kill Ennius Tullus (380 HP). He uses melee attacks (pray Protect from Melee), and can only be attacked with melee, using three special attacks:
** Sunfire Blast: Circles will begin glowing around the area, indicating safespots for his upcoming attack.
** Sunfire Strike: A row or column of sunfire through him. If the player is diagonally across, he will likewise launch one across himself.
** Sunfire Smite: Disables the player's overhead prayers.
** Upon reaching 0 health, he will enter the enrage phase, healing 120 health, attacking faster, and Sunfire Strike is enhanced to cover three rows/columns at a time.

steps.title: The Tonali Cavern
steps.content:
- * After the cutscene, descend into the Tonali Cavern.
* Make your way across the agility shortcuts or portals to reach the northern end of the cavern.
* Inspect the Strange Platform, as this unlocks an entrance from the surface directly east of Tal Teklan.
* Proceed north slightly, and descend east into the sun puzzle room.
* Search all the urns for Kuhu essence.
* The altars are numbered 1 to 8, with the first being the north-east altar and the next number in sequence going clockwise.
* Inspect the sun statue for your puzzle; the wording will determine where you and Prince Itzla need to be positioned (The third number/word is not used):
** Oma {{= 2
** Naui  4
** Kuli  5
** Chaki  6
** Koma  7
** Ueai  8
** Makti  10
* For example, if the statue states "Naui Koma-Makti", Itzla needs to be placed by the fourth altar, while you need to go to the seventh altar.
* Inspect the sun statue for the next engraving.
* After successfully imbuing an altar three times, the puzzle is complete.
* Descend west into the moon puzzle room.
* Use pressure plates to move Prince Itzla and suppress a set of flames.
* Search the old tools and obtain a knife blade.
* Pull the tree roots around the room for some ancient roots.
* Use the knife blade on the roots for some root kindling.
* Count the total amount of lit braziers from stepping on both pressure plates
** Count the lit braziers while Itzla is standing on one pressure plate, tell him to move, count the lit braziers. Add the two numbers up, and that's how many kindlings you need to add to the statue. The total number will not change until you add the correct amount of kindlings.
* Deposit the equivalent amount of root kindling in the moon statue.
* Doing so correctly three times will complete the puzzle.
* Leave the puzzle through the portal.
* Follow Prince Itzla to unlock the northern doors.
* Return to the surface and resupply for the final fight if needed; ranged style is recommended.
}}

steps.title: The Truth of Mokhaiotl
steps.content:
- * Return to the entrance to Mokhaiotl via Lift Platform (Crypt of Tonali) then traveling north. Enter the door to initiate a cutscene.
* Defeat Augur Metzli. She has 600 Hitpoints, and uses special attacks every three attacks, after which she sometimes switches from ranged to magic and vice versa.
** Dodge flame walls via a gap or gold symbol to teleport to a safe area.
** She also uses the same special attacks used by Lucius and Ennius earlier. She may do them multiple times in a row.
** Upon reaching 10% of her health, she will enter the enrage phase. She will target the quadrant that the player and Itzla are on. A white portal will additionally spawn to move to the next quadrant, avoiding damage from the attack.
* After defeating Metzli, make your way to the next entrance at the northern end by using the stairs or jumping across the pillar (requires 75 Agility).
* Enter the final chamber to initiate a cutscene. Note that clicking elsewhere during the dialogue will reset the player back outside the room. Should this happen, you will have to watch the cutscene again.
* After the cutscene, search the skeleton next to the entrance for a stone tablet. Read it.
* Inspect the Sun Statue and Moon Statue.
* Interact with the final chamber to return to the Crypt of Tonali.
* Finish the final conversation with Prince Itzla.
* Congratulations, quest complete!

steps.title: =Potion=
steps.content:
thumb|300px|A visual explanation of the solution.
- *Go upstairs.
*Open the door, then take the notes from the eastern cupboard.
*Take the cleansing fluid from the northern table. The position will be random for everyone. Look at the notes to see the riddle: the fluids are listed in order of 1-2-3-4-5 (e.g. if cleansing fluid is the second potion mentioned in the fourth sentence, it is number 5).
**Warning: If you choose the wrong potion, you will take high damage (25+) and become poisoned. This can be avoided by logging out before advancing the dialogue.

**From E to C
**From W to E
**From C to W
**From C to E
**From W to E
**From W to C
**From E to C
**From E to W

**From E to C
**From W to E
**From W to C
**From E to C
*Go downstairs and get Dinh's hammer from the display case.

*Return to Lady Vulcana Lovakengj.

steps.title: A disturbance in Rellekka
steps.content:
Items required: Mirror shield, + if you still need 2 kegs of beer. 

Recommended: a weapon to kill a level 53 Basilisk Youngling
- *Buy 2 kegs of beer from Thora in the Longhall before you start the quest to save time later. (bank them when you have the chance to reduce weight while running around)
*Talk to Brundt in the Longhall to start the quest.  
*Go north and talk to Freygerd in the house south of the sandpit.
*Equip your mirror shield (to avoid taking damage and stat drain), then search the sandpit (to the north) and kill the Basilisk Youngling (level 53). 
*Pick up the Unsealed letter and read it.
*Search the rockslide west of the house to get the Fang.
*Search the boxes south of the house to get the Venom gland.
*Talk to Freygerd to give her the items.
*Return to Brundt to receive a note, read it, then talk to him again for a cutscene.  or 
*Go south-east of Rellekka, following the dirt path, and talk to Brundt. Go through all chat options to learn how to restore V's shield. 
}}

steps.title: Redeeming the exile
steps.content: You can do the following sections in any order as long as you use them on each other while you have a glassblowing pipe.

steps.title: =Fremennik shield=
steps.content:
Items required: Rune thrownaxe and pet rock for option 3. 

Recommended: Stamina potions, food, Ring of charos (a).
- *Obtain a Fremennik shield (this is not the tradeable Neitiznot shield).
**Option 1: Go to Waterbirth Island and kill dagannoth until they drop the shield (uncommon drop).
**Option 2: Go to Rellekka and kill Market Guards or Warriors until they drop the shield (rare drop).
**Option 3: Travel to Bardur deep in the Waterbirth Dungeon and wear a Ring of charos (a) to get the shield for free. Without the ring it will cost

steps.title: =Lunar glass and V's sigil=
steps.content:
Items required: Seal of passage, molten glass, 100 astral runes, any pickaxe, hammer, and an amulet of glory for a fast teleport to a furnace.
- *Go to Baba Yaga on Lunar Isle to turn your molten glass into molten glass (i).  if using lunar spellbook and Ourania teleport is not unlocked.
*Head north-east of the town to Lunar Isle mine and mine stalagmites for 3 lunar ore.
*Leave the mine and travel to the Astral Altar with 100 astral runes in your inventory and craft on the altar to obtain Lunar glass. Then return to Rellekka.
**Optional: Destroy the Seal of passage and talk to the Oneiromancer to be teleported there. This guide will remind you later to re-obtain it at a convenient moment.
*Smelt 3 lunar bars in a furnace (Rellekka is convenient) or you can use Superheat Item.
*Smith the V sigil on an anvil (Rellekka is convenient).
*Talk to the Fossegrimen to enchant the sigil. (Found by summoning at the Strange altar south-west of Rellekka) .
}}

steps.title: =Polishing rock=
steps.content:
Items required: Pet rock, Fishing rod, V sigil (e), Lunar glass, Ice gloves, Glassblowing pipe, Fremennik shield. 

Recommended: 2 teleports to the Mountain Camp (Slayer ring or Fairy rings access code ), a teleport back to Rellekka (Enchanted Lyre or Fremennik Sea boots) and stamina potion
- *Head east of Rellekka to the Mountain Camp
*Follow the path north of the Mountain Camp and inspect the Large Geyser. Use your pet rock on the Geyser.

steps.title: Basilisks in the Market
steps.content:
Items required: ''V's shield, combat equipment, food, 2 kegs of beer (If you forgot to buy them at the quest start, buy them from Rasolo or on the Grand Exchange. Keg of beer from the table in the Longhall does not work.) You can go ahead and bring the recommended items for the next step as well.''
-

steps.title: Island of Stone
steps.content:
Items required: ''V's shield, combat equipment to fight Typhor (level 218) and The Jormungand (level 363), a one-handed weapon '''(must wield V's shield)

Recommended:' 1-2 super restore(4), high-healing food. Sarachnis Cudgel, Leaf-bladed battleaxe, Zombie axe, dragon mace, or a dragon warhammer are good weapon choices as the monster is weak to crush. Note that the Zombie helmet provides the highest crush boost of all helmets.
- *Speak with Brundt to explain the cave door puzzle.
*Solve the cave door puzzle (Mastermind).
**Each red check means one rune is correct but in the wrong position.
**Each green check means one rune is correct and in the right position.

steps.title: The jester outfit
steps.content:
Items required: Raw tuna, tin/coal/mithril ores (based on mining levels, see item requirements above)
- *Talk to Mord Gunnars at the most northern dock in Rellekka to be taken to Jatizso.

steps.title: The spymaster's first task
Bridge repairs
steps.content:
Items required: 8 rope, 8 split logs, a knife, one free inventory space

Optional: Food, Prayer potions, armour to tank the level 85 Ice trolls.
- *Speak to Mawnis Burowgar again without the Jester Outfit
*Speak to Mawnis Burowgar with the ropes, split logs, and knife in your inventory with at least one empty inventory slot.
**If you do not have split logs, chop Arctic Pine trees until you have eight logs and use them on the Woodcutting stumps just east of the bank.
**If you are crafting your own shield, then cut two extra logs now.
**If you do not have any rope, kill yaks outside in the yak pen and spin their hair in the south-easternmost building.
*Speak to Thakkrad to learn how to repair the bridges. 
Note: Keep Protect from Missiles on at all times while repairing the bridges as any damage taken is stacked and applied after the bridge repair animation completes.
- *Travel north, across the rope bridge and repair the broken bridges on the east and west sides of the island (right-click option to repair).
*Talk to Mawnis Burowgar.
*Quick travel back to Rellekka via Maria Gunnars at the dock to the south-west.

steps.title: The king's tax collector
steps.content:
Optional items: 5000 coins for black market yak trading after the quest
- *Quick travel to Jatizso via Mord.
*Speak with King Gjuki Sorvott IV in the building west of the bank.
*Tax the shop keepers of Jatizso:
**Hring Hring must pay 8,000, he is in the south-western most house.
**Skuli Myrka must pay 6,000, north from Hring.
**Vanligga Gastfrihet must pay 5,000, north from kings palace. (Offer to pay her taxes for her; this provides the capability to trade in black market yak goods after the quest.)
**Keepa Kettilon must pay 5,000, east from Vanligga.
*Talk to King Gjuki Sorvott IV.
*Collect taxes from the following people for 1,000:
**Hring Hring.
**Raum Urda-Stein in the same house as Hring Hring.
**Skuli Myrka.
**Keepa Kettilon.
**Flosi Dalksson in the same house as Keepa Kettilon.
*Speak with King Gjuki Sorvott IV.
*Quick travel back to Rellekka via Mord.

steps.title: The spymaster's second task
steps.content:
Items required: Silly jester hat; Silly jester top; Silly jester tights; Silly jester boots; Yak-hide armour (top) and Yak-hide armour (legs) OR 15 coins, needle, one or more thread, and three yak hide; Neitiznot shield OR two Arctic pine logs, one bronze nail, a hammer, and rope.
- *Quick travel to Neitiznot via Maria.
*Speak with Spymaster Slug Hemligssen again.
*Equip only the jester outfit again.
*Speak with Mawnis to induce another Jester cutscene.
*Speak with Slug once again.

steps.title: The troll king
steps.content:
Items required: Neitiznot shield, one-handed weapon, food, Prayer potions, combat potions, emergency teleport.

Note: Use a Melee weapon as the troll king has high Magic and Ranged Defence.

- *Equip the Neitiznot shield and combat items to fight the Ice Troll King.
**Equipping it is actually not required to enter the cave, or to fight the king, but it will heavily reduce damage, thus it is highly recommended.Note: This is a multi-combat zone. Melee and Ranged Ice Trolls will attack you.
- Make sure to equip the Neitiznot shield.
*Use Protect from Melee while running to the east side cave entrance of the farthest north isle.
*Enter the cave to start a cutscene.
**Talk to Bork Sigmundson to obtain 10 Tuna, 3 Prayer potion (3), and 3 Strength potion (4). If you do not have enough inventory space  when you request the items, you will not be able to obtain them again.
*Kill ten trolls, you will see a message saying "You have defeated enough trolls to attack the King."''
*Turn on Protect from Missiles before crossing the bridge.
*Turn on Protect from Magic for the duration of the fight. Kill the troll king. DO NOT use Protect from Melee because King will use the long distance attack as Dad does.
*Decapitate the troll king's corpse.
*Return to Mawnis Burowgar.
Optional: Make sure to claim the prayer potions from Bork Sigmundson at the entrance.
*Congratulations, quest complete!
* The Fremennik Exiles

steps.title: Starting out
steps.content: - *Talk to Brundt in the longhall to start the quest. (Fairy ring

steps.title: Manni the Reveller, Sigli the Huntsman, and Olaf the Bard
steps.content:
- *Talk to Manni the Reveller while in the longhall. 
*If you did not bring a beer, grab the beer tankard now.
*Talk to Sigli the Huntsman outside, near the entrance of the longhall, to obtain the Hunters' Talisman. 
*Talk to Olaf the Bard just east of the longhall. 
*Talk to Olaf again. 
*To get a lyre, either make it yourself (Requires    and 6 free inventory spaces) or kill Lanzig (1/17 drop rate). Killing lanzig takes longer on average. You must enchant it either way.
**Option 1: Making the lyre yourself (Items required: Axe of any kind, knife)
***Walk to the Swaying tree that is east of the entrance to Rellekka (north-west of the Golden Apple Tree at ) at the rare trees icon. Chop a branch and fletch an unstrung lyre.
***Talk to Lalli to the south-east of the Swaying tree, ask about the other human. 
***Talk to Askeladden just outside the longhall entrance to get a pet rock.
***Pick a cabbage, potato, and onion from the farming patch in the south-east corner of Rellekka.
***Return to Lalli, and offer the pet rock.
***Use the cabbage, potato, onion, and pet rock on Lalli's Stew (cauldron).
***Talk to Lalli again to get the golden fleece.
***Spin the golden fleece on a spinning wheel and use it on the unstrung lyre. (See the next section to spin the wool)
**Option 2: Killing Lanzig (takes a long time with bad luck)
***Lanzig lives in a hut just east of the entrance to the longhall. Kill Lanzig until he drops the lyre (1/17 drop rate). Safespottable at the firepit or outside his door.
}}

steps.title: Seers' Village
Back to Rellekka
steps.content:
- *Use a Rellekka house teleport to return, or simply walk back. If walking, left-click on your talisman to check if The Draugen is nearby on your way. If so, kill him.
*Use the beer, or beer tankard, on the council workman by the bridge south of Rellekka to obtain strange object.
*Go north across the bridge, then walk a bit west until you see a small narrow path heading south into the water. (The large rib cage sticking out of the water on the left side of the bridge)
*Use your raw shark/manta ray/sea turtle on the strange altar to enchant your lyre.
*Follow your talisman by left-clicking on it and kill The Draugen now if you haven't already. Appears as a grey butterfly before locating the correct tile. 
*Once done, head back into Rellekka and talk to Sigli at the entrance.
*Head to the outside of the longhall to the pipe on the eastern wall. Use a tinderbox on your strange object and use the lit strange object on the pipe.
*Enter the north-eastern back door of the longhall, walk onto the stage, and play your enchanted lyre.
*Exit the back door, enter the main long hall, and take a keg of beer off the table.
*Use your low alcohol keg on the keg of beer.
*Challenge Manni to a drinking contest again.

steps.title: Sigmund the Merchant and Swensen the Navigator
steps.content:
- NOTE: If at any point you start to get several members telling you something along the lines of "No, sorry, can't help." - You missed a step. Go back. 

*Talk to Sigmund The Merchant in the market west of the longhall. 
*Talk to Olaf the Bard just east of the longhall. 
*Talk to Yrsa at the clothing store west of the market. 
*Talk to Brundt the Chieftain in the longhall.  or  if you are doing or have finished Mountain Daughter
*Talk to Sigli the Huntsman just south of the longhall. 
*Talk to Skulgrimen in the hut just north of the longhall. 
*Talk to the Fisherman north of the market. 
*Talk to Swensen the Navigator in the building south of the market. 
*Talk to Swensen again. 
*Climb down the ladder and take the South, West, East, North, South, East, then North portals. Climb up the ladder.
*Talk to Peer the Seer just north-west of Swensen. 
*Talk to Thorvald the Warrior in the hut just north of the longhall. 
*Talk to Manni the Reveller in the longhall. 
*Talk to Thora the Barkeep in the longhall. 
*Talk to Askeladden in front of the longhall, pay him 5,000 coins. 
*Head back and talk to (in order): 
**Thora
**Manni
**Thorvald
**Peer
**Swensen
**Fisherman
**Skulgrimen
**Sigli
**Brundt
**Yrsa
**Olaf
**Sailor
**Sigmund
}}

steps.title: [[Thorvald]] the Warrior
steps.content:
- *Go to a bank (The Seers' Village bank is close) and deposit all of your items (you cannot have any weapons, armour, or runes).
*Bring equipment for the fight:
**A dramen branch (Note: Requires {{SCP|Crafting|31 and must have started Lost City), celastrus bark (requires ), or a goblin paint cannon
**A knife (optional - only bring if you are not using a goblin paint cannon)
**A stat boosting amulet
**A Combat bracelet
**Plenty of food, potions, and rings of recoil
*Talk to Thorvald just north of the longhall. 
*Climb down the ladder. If you have a knife and dramen branch, cut it into a staff and equip it. You can also use celastrus bark to fletch a battlestaff.
*Fight the first 3 forms of Koschei the Deathless without weapons, armour, or runes. (You can pray flick him for the first 3 forms, but be careful as dying in these forms is dangerous for Hardcore Ironmen AND Group Hardcore Ironmen). Do not go up the ladder after completing the 3rd form - it is safe to die from the 4th form.
*You can choose to let the 4th form kill you (this IS safe for Hardcore Ironmen AND Group Hardcore Ironmen as Koschei will not actually finish you in this form; the player will faint and wake up upstairs rather than being killed), or you can kill it (slower and is not necessary).
*Talk to Thorvald again.
}}

steps.content:

thumb|center|500px|The locations of searchable objects in the dungeon beneath Lake Molch Island.

steps.title: Halfway there

- *Once in Blasidar's house, talk to Riki the sculptor's model to give him the clothes, axe and boots.
*Talk to Blasidar. Watch the cutscene.

steps.title: Joining the consortium
steps.content:
Items required: various ores, various bars, Stamina/Energy potions

Note: If you want this section to go quicker, choose a company closer to West Keldagrim bank or Blast Furnace depending on how you're obtaining the ores.

Warning!: *Do not hop worlds or you will lose your progress!*
- Lazy tip: rather than go back and forth you can just fill your inventory with say copper, and get a new task before closing the dialogue until you get copper.

*Go to the upper floor of the market and talk to the secretary of any company except the Red Axe.

- *After you enter and talk to Glough, a level 172 black demon will appear and attack you.

steps.title: Starting out
steps.content:
Items required: 30 Coins
Recommended: 10 Quetzal feed, 3 limestone brick, and 4 soft clay to build the Unbuilt Landing Site in Salvager Overlook. Also bring MELEE combat gear unless you want to bank between the trials.

- * Talk to Prince Itzla Arkan at the Teomat to start the quest.  
* Enter the south-eastern room in the same building (there is no basement) and rest on the bed.
* Talk to the Prince.
* Talk to the shopkeeper in the general store east of the pub about help. 
* Return to the rented room in the pub and talk to the Prince again.
* Go through the large gate to the north and run all the way east to the Tower of Ascension and talk to the Prince  (just outside the entrance to the tower with the dungeon icon on the minimap).
** Optionally, build the Unbuilt Landing Site in the Salvager Overlook on your way there if you haven't already done so.
* Talk to the nearby recruits, Nova, Sergius, Felius, and Caritta.
* Talk to the Prince again  (make sure you don't have a pet following you, or you'll be unable to proceed)
* Enter the tower to the west and talk to Forebearer Janus and climb the stairs.}}

steps.title: The First Trial
steps.content:
Items required: Five empty inventory slots

*Note* if you need to leave for any reason, you may do so only AFTER completing the current trial. Leaving before finishing and talking to Forebearer Janus will result in having to redo current trial.- * Pickpocket the Emissary Ascended in the caged area on the

steps.title: The Second Trial
steps.content:
Recommended: Combat gear, prayer potions, energy potions

- * This is a wave-based combat trial, with melee and mage enemies attacking two at a time, then four at a time. Some of them do a 3x3 AOE attack which can be dodged. Use the bandages from the medical boxes around the room to heal Prince Itzla by left click Healing him during the fight as needed.
* Speak to Forebearer Janus again to start the next trial.

steps.title: The Third Trial
steps.content:
- *Talk to the prince
* You must question each member of the cult to work out who the traitor is. Choose the person who mentions anything about Mictl as this is not part of the Emissaries' beliefs.
* Once you question each one, you'll be given the option to accuse them while talking to them. 
** If none of the members are the traitor you may need to exit and re-enter the floor.

steps.title: The Final Trial
steps.content:
Items required: Four empty inventory slots- * Go up the stairs.
* Fight Prince Itzla. 
** Pray melee against his basic attacks.
**He has two special attacks, both of which he warns you about. The sword swipe turns off any protection prayers, but you can turn them straight back on. The other is an AOE attack, once he warns you he is going to do it, run behind him immediately to dodge.
**He is immune to special attacks. (NOTE: If using a Scythe of Vitur; you must unequip it and punch or kick to finish the fight.)
* Talk to Forebearer Janus.
* Search the chest south to obtain a set of Twilight Emissary robes.
* Equip the emissary robes, speak to Prince Itzla to have him follow you, and then enter the temple to the east.
* After the cutscene, speak with Prince Itzla and then speak with Forebearer Fides.
* Enter the ruins south of the temple and go down the stairs.

steps.title: Ice Dungeon
steps.content:
- * Take a pickaxe from the barrel near the entrance.
* Mine the rocks.
* Run past the Frost Nagua and the spikes and pull the first lever.
* Climb-Down the Ledge, run past the frost crabs while avoiding the traps. 
** Throughout the cave, several traps deal 10 Hitpoints of damage. You can avoid them or tank the damage.
* Slide along the icy ledge, and then enter the room in the north-east and pull the second lever.
* Continue through the cave and jump over the frozen platforms to get to the west side. 
* Climb down another ledge, and run into the north-western room with stone chests to pull the third lever
* Walk south-west to the large gate and pull the fourth lever located on the northern wall next to the gate. Note: If you forgot a lever, not all braziers will be lit and the gate will be closed.
** Pull the chain before continuing, as this will allow you to climb up and down it in the future.

steps.title: Statue Puzzle
steps.content:
- * Walk west through the gate and search urns to collect three coloured icons. 
** Level 104 Frost Nagua will continue to spawn and attack you while searching. Protect from Magic will negate the damage from their regular attacks.
* Fix the broken statues in the western area with the corresponding coloured icons.
* Inspect the four markings in the four corners of the area. The first word describes the order in which to activate the four statues to open the frozen door.
** Different for every player: check the murals and they will have Zema (1), Oma (2), Yeya (3), or Naui (4). Touch the statues in the order determined by the markings (1-4).
* Go through the door, prepared to fight the final boss.

steps.title: Final Boss
steps.content:
- * Fight the Amoxliatl.
** Pray magic
** Step away from the spikes
** Avoid standing on the ice pools
** Re-enable protect from magic when it is disabled
** The blocks she summons will deal area damage and heal her, melee them to destroy them. (higher level players can leave these and just attack with fire spells) 
* Head to the Sunrise Palace and speak to Servius, Teokan of Ralos to finish up the quest.

- *Speak to Cassius by the pond Northwest of Lumbridge 
*Speak to Seth Groats
*Search the shelves in Seth's farmhouse for The groats principles book
*Return to Cassius with the book, receiving a Milk sample from him
*Drink the Milk sample in front of Cassius, who will give you a second Milk sample to take to Duke Horacio
*Speak to Duke Horacio in Lumbridge Castle
*Speak to Gillie Groats
*Drink the Milk sample in front of Gillie Groats, who will offer you a permit for dealing with the bull
*Open the pen in the north-east corner of the cow farm and fight the bull
*Speak to Gillie Groats
*Speak to Cassius

steps.title: Bolren's Little Dumpling
steps.content:
thumb|Path for the monolith puzzle
- * Talk to King Bolren in the Tree Gnome Village. 
** If you don't have a Tree Gnome Village Dungeon key and Golrie is trapped behind the gate, search the distinct crate in the eastern area of the dungeon.
** Unlock the gate and speak to Golrie again.
* Enter the storeroom via the tunnel in the eastern area of the dungeon.
* Push the monolith north.
* Search the nearby chest for some discs.
* Push the south-west monolith north.
* Push the north-west monolith east.
* Search the two chests by the northern tunnel. 
* Push the small monolith south.
* Push the north-west monolith west.
* Search the chest for the strongroom key and crystal chime seed.
* Click on the singing bowl to create the crystal chime from the seed. You may have to instead select the 'Sing-crystal' on the singing bowl to complete this step. 
* Push the south-east monolith west.
* Enter the strongroom to the west.
* Click the book on the lectern and watch each cutscene by selecting the chapter headers. (NOTE: DROPPED ITEMS WILL DISAPPEAR AFTER THE CUTSCENE)
* Operate Yewnock's machine. 
* Referencing the table to the right, insert discs on the left side of the machine to equal the values on the right side. Use Yewnock's exchanger to obtain shapes of lesser values. (NOTE: PICK UP ANY ITEMS YOU'VE DROPPED PRIOR TO CONFIRMING THE DISCS IN YEWNOCK'S MACHINE). If you are having trouble, see the full guide here.
* Return to King Bolren and kill the evil creature.
* Talk to him again.
}}

steps.title: The Warped Depths
steps.content:
- * Use the Spirit Tree to travel to the Tree Gnome Stronghold.
* Make your way to the Grand Tree and climb up the ladder once.
* Talk to Gianne jnr. in the north-west corner.  and then running north-west. Alternatively, teleporting to Castle Wars via ring of dueling, then heading south-west alongside the river is also fairly quick.
* Use a crossbow and mith grapple on the tree in the middle of the river to cross into the mountains.
* Talk to Longramble.
* Talk to the dying spirit tree.
* Use the crystal chime on the tree. Note: Keep the Crystal chime in your inventory after this, as it needs to be in your inventory to damage the dungeon monsters.
* Talk to the tree.
* Go west into the Poison Waste Dungeon entrance by entering the sewer and climbing up the ladder.
* Travel through the dungeon until you reach a room with a pit in the centre that is connected to three other rooms.
** The Warped Tortoises scattered throughout the dungeon are not aggressive, but the Warped Terrorbirds are. Wearing Earmuffs or a Slayer helm will reduce damage taken from their Ranged attacks. The damage can be fully negated if ear protection is combined with the Protect from Missiles prayer.
* Enter the east room and kill the three blue Warped Terrorbirds.
** The Terrorbirds can attack with both Ranged and Melee and will swap to whichever combat style the player is not currently praying against. It is possible to use the pillars in the room as safespots. If fighting in melee range, it is recommended to use Protect from Melee as their melee max hit is much higher than their ranged max hit.
* Finish the final dialogue with Hazelmere to complete the quest.
}}

steps.title: Starting out
steps.content:
Item required: Commorb. Recommended item: Ardougne teleport
- *Talk to Sir Tiffy Cashien in Falador Park to get a Commorb v2. 
*Talk to the following people in Witchaven in any order:
**Talk to Brother Maledict (church)
**Talk to Mayor Hobb (most north-west building) . After Savant prompts you, scan with your Commorb v2.
**Talk to Holgart (green shirt, north-east of quest icon, by the boat to the Fishing Platform)
*Talk to Col. O'Niall again.
}}

steps.title: The shrine
steps.content:
Item required: Commorb.
Recommended item: Necklace of passage
- *Climb down the Old Ruin Entrance (Dungeon sign) west of Witchaven.
*Push the false wall on the east wall by the entrance (red on minimap).
*Follow the path to the imposing door, using the shortcut if able, try to open it.
*Scan with the Commorb v2 to acquire the door transcription (make sure you have one free inventory space).
*Pick up a dead sea slug just west of the imposing door. (If you do not pick up the dead sea slug, you will not be able to talk to Jorral).
*Talk to Jorral in the outpost (necklace of passage) north-west of Ardougne.

steps.title: The pages
steps.content:
thumb|325px|The solution of the puzzle.
Items required: 1 swamp paste, the Commorb, a dead seaslug, and 5 free inventory spaces
- *Talk to Col. O'Niall.
*Talk to Brother Maledict.
*Go to the mayor's house and search the study desk until you get a page.
*Talk to Ezekial Lovecraft in the fishing store (make sure you have one free inventory space).
*Talk to Col. O'Niall (make sure you have 3 free inventory spaces)
*Use swamp paste on one of the fragments. Savant will stop you.
*Talk to Jeb (near Holgart) and travel to the Fishing Platform.
*Talk to Bailey on the south-west part Fishing Platform, give him the dead slug.
*Use the sea slug glue on a fragment, then solve the puzzle.

steps.title: The imposing door
steps.content:
Items required: chisel, 5+ rune or pure essence, the Commorb, melee combat equipment, talismans to enter the respective altars (not needed if using abyss)
- *Right click the pages and select shape-options on the pages to shape essence into air, water, fire, earth, and mind.
**Note: It is possible and likely to fail and break the essence.
*Use the chiselled stones on their respective Runic altar. It is recommended to bring extra rune essence in case they are destroyed.
**Air: the Air Altar is south of Falador
**Mind: the Mind Altar is north of Falador (just below the Wilderness)
**Water: the Water Altar is south of Lumbridge (next to the shack to Zanaris)
**Earth: the Earth Altar is north-east of Varrock (you can use balloon transport system if unlocked)
**Fire: the Fire Altar is west of the Emir's Arena in Al Kharid (you can use ring of dueling)
***Note: It is possible and likely to fail this step as well.
*Use the handmade runes on the imposing door in the cave underneath Witchaven. Make sure to bring the Commorb with you.
*Kill the level 62 Slug Prince, only melee can damage it and it drains your Prayer points.
**Note: It is possible to safespot with a halberd
*Talk to Sir Tiffy Cashien.

You now need to gain 75% support to finish the quest. You may speak with Advisor Ghrim to check your rating (The quest log will also update once you have a high enough rating). Once you have reached 100% approval rating, your chat box tells you that you've completed a hard task for your Fremennik achievement diaries. 

Perform any of the following actions to increase your rating:
- *Buy Mixed flowers from Flower Girl. (This is the fastest but most click-intensive method, as each flower must be bought individually through dialogue. Exactly 1,875 GP is needed to go from the base 25% approval to the 75% minimum)
*Rake the herbs and flax outside the palace walls. (World hopping does NOT reset the patches, however weeds respawn in approximately 1 minute.)
*Mine coal on the north side of Miscellania.
*Chop maple trees in the centre of Miscellania.
*Fish tuna, lobsters, or swordfish by the docks of Miscellania.
You can force weeds to become fully grown by hopping worlds after they have started growing. It will take about 8 minutes to reach 100% approval using this method. Alternatively, for players with high Mining and a good pickaxe, mining coal can reach 100% approval in around 10 minutes.

- *Speak with King Vargas once at 75%
*Congratulations, quest complete!

steps.title: =Fix the pressure machine=
steps.content:
- *Take the following supplies (by searching the crates inside the tower):
**4 Valve wheels
**3 Metal sheets
**4 Coloured balls
*Head up the first staircase on the west side of the tower.
*Fix the pressure machine on the north side of the room.
*Complete the puzzle (turn the valves until all holes are plugged, pull the levers when necessary).
**Pipe 2: Pull down the left lever, and then turn the 2nd valve left twice. Turn it right until the pipe is filled with water.
**Pipe 4: Pull down the right lever and turn the 4th valve right three times, then left once. Turn it right until the pipe is filled with water.
**Pipe 3: Lift the right lever back up, and turn the 3rd valve right twice and then left once. Turn it right until the pipe is filled with water.
**Pipe 1: Lift up the left lever and turn the 1st valve left twice. Turn it right until the pipe is filled with water.
*Once all the holes are plugged, make sure to turn the valves until all of the pipes are filled with water. You should see a message that says "The machine is working!" when you have completed the puzzle.

steps.title: The Great Conch
steps.content:
- * Floopa will board your boat automatically. Sail to the south shore of The Great Conch.
* Disembark and talk to Floopa on the Docks.
* Enter the village to the north and speak with Elder Raley (first house on the right, south-east of town) to receive a list of repairs.
* Acquire the following repair materials; this can be done in batches if low on inventory space:
** A saw can be found in Elder Raley's house if you did not bring one.
** Take a hammer from the building with the anvil and furnace. 
** Pick up 6 Tortugan Scute scattered around town.
** Run west and chop 10 Jatoba Logs from the Jatoba Trees (there is a bronze axe which can be picked up from a tree stump north of the calquat tree patch).
** Pick up 6 sea shells near beach (closest spawn is to the south-east of town).

steps.title: Making repairs
steps.content:
- * Repair Elder Krill's stall (the fish stall on the north side of the marketplace):
** 1 sea shell, 1 Tortugan scute, 2 Jatoba logs.
* Repair the south wall of Elder Krill's store (directly north of his marketplace stall):
** 2 Tortugan scute, 2 Jatoba logs.
* Repair the north wall of Elder Strom's store (west of the marketplace):
** 2 Tortugan scutes, 2 Jatoba logs.
* Repair Elder Strom's crate (On the west side of the marketplace, east outside of his store):
** 2 sea shells, 1 Jatoba log.
* Repair Elder Coco's stall (on the south side of the marketplace - Crafting stall)
** 1 sea shell, 1 Tortugan scute, 2 Jatoba logs.
* Repair Elder Coco's crate (directly south of his marketplace stall, north of the building)
** 2 sea shells, 1 Jatoba log.
* Speak to Elder Raley again.

steps.title: Tracking the Gryphon
steps.content:
Items required: Any axe, combat gear, and food to defeat a level 95 Gryphon
- * Track the Gryphon:
** Inspect the monument in the center of the market to reveal footprints.
** Where the trail ends, inspect nearby objects like flowers, rockslides, and plants to pick up the trail again.
** Clear the roots blocking the cave entrance with your axe.
* Enter cave and defeat the Gryphon (level 95).
* Exit the cave and return to Elder Raley in town.
** You can climb the rocks south of the cave (with level 50 Agility) for a quick way back to town.

steps.title: Attack on the Little Pearl
steps.content:
Items required:  Combat gear, food, and prayer to defeat the level 235 Shellbane Gryphon. Your cape slot will be filled with the Tortugan shield.
- * Talk to Elder Blunn at the north-eastern stall in the marketplace to receive a Tortugan shield, a cape-slot item. Keep this equipped for the fight!
* Use the bank in town to prepare for battle.
* Sail to The Little Pearl, south-east of The Great Conch.
* Disembark and a cutscene will play. Immediately after the cutscene, the battle will begin. Defeat the shellbane gryphon.
** Use either Protect from Melee or Ranged.
** Fighting with Ranged or Magic is recommended to negate one of his mechanics. This fight can be done without taking damage if using ranged and mechanics are handled properly, but supplies are still suggested.
** It can charge you and perform a knockback that hits for up to 65 damage if your equipped weight is under 40 kg. If blocked by a tree or eggs, it will not perform this.
** It will occasionally spit out an orange orb. Move 1 tile away.
** When "The gryphon aggressively flaps it wings..." is displayed in the chatbox, whirlwinds will spawn under you for a few seconds and then explode shortly after. Move repeatedly off of the affected tiles to avoid damage.
* '''Don't leave yet: Talk to Korel about the strange ship you saw.
* Return to The Great Conch and talk to Elder Raley again.
*Congratulations, quest complete!'''

steps.content:
Items required: A plank, a spade, and 4 inventory spaces needed
- *You can now pray Rapid Heal for the duration of this step (there is an altar up ahead). Run west past the zombie camp, there will be five sets of odd markings along the walls of the corridor (You must attempt to disable the wall traps or walk past them).
**Grab the plank by the furnace if you did not grab one earlier.
*You will reach an altar, take the north path using the plank on the flat rocks.
*Take the orb and walk back to the altar.
*Take the north-west path with the ogres and blessed spiders. Take the orb.
*Take the centre-most west path, traversing the flat rocks using the plank. Take the orb.
*Take the final path, do not pick up the orb, but search the rock beneath instead and disarm the trap to get the orb.
*Return to the zombie camp to the east.
*Use the 4 orbs on the furnace.
*Return to the altar, turn off Rapid Heal/pray at altar and climb down the well.
*Optional: Search the two stacked crates in the room you landed in to find 2 salmon and 2 meat pies.
center

*Use your spade on the loose mud at (2).
*Go west and cross the ledge at (3).
**Note: You may fall down off the ledge and have to go back to the slave cage again at (2).
*If you have 50 thieving, take the short cut at (5) - avoid the bubbles!
*If you lack 50 thieving, cross the stone bridge maze to get to the other side. (4)
*Squeeze-through the pipe at (6).

steps.title: Cold blooded killing
steps.content:
- *Search the unicorn cage.
*Walk through the path south of the cage and use the piece of railing on the boulder above the unicorn.
*Search the cage again to get the Unicorn horn. You can drop the piece of railing.
*Pass-through the tunnel and follow the cave until you reach the 3 knights.
**Optional: Talk to any of the knights (Sir Jerro, Sir Carl, or Sir Harry) to receive 2 meat pie, 2 bread, a stew, a Attack potion(2), and a Prayer potion(2).
*Kill them and take their badges.
**You can safespot them by standing in the hallway to the south.
*Continue forward, using your plank on either flat rock, until you see a well.
*Use the badges and unicorn horn on the well.
*Open the door.

steps.title: Iban's cavern
steps.content:
thumb|659x659px
- Note: You can now drop your spade and plank (and the extra rope, if you brought 2 in the beginning).
*Run south as far as you can (see map), and descend into the cave (yellow dot on map).

**Note: You can also talk to Kamen and either accept his beer (reduces Agility level and causes damage) or decline and purchase the food for 75 coins. If you accept his beer, you take 5 damage and your Agility level is reduced by 3 each time you do. You need 4 free inventory slots in the next section.
*Talk to Klank the dwarf.

steps.content:

steps.title: Starting out
steps.content:
- *Enter the top floor of the Watchtower.
**It is possible to use another player's Watchtower portal to get here. Use World 330 (House Party) to find a host, look for the "Yanille portal".
**Otherwise, use the Nightmare Zone Minigame Teleport or use fairy ring

steps.title: Getting the relic pieces and the first crystal
steps.content:
- *Talk to Og north-west of Yanille to receive Toban's key.  and head west. 
**If you use a ring of dueling, teleport to Castle Wars and head south past the bridges and then north-east until you find a tribe of ogres.
*Head south and get onto the island by using a rope with the branch (not the tree) of the long-branched tree that is west of the island.
*Talk to Grew. 
*Enter the hole south of Gu'Tanoth (the "Tunnel to Toban" on map above, dungeon icon south of Jiggig, and north-west of some ruins).
**To get there, use a Feldip Hills teleport and run north, use fairy ring  or use a ring of dueling teleport to Castle Wars and run south past Jiggig.
**Pick up the death rune south of the hole if needed.
*Kill Gorad and take his tooth (be sure to have room in your inventory or you won't receive the tooth).
*Talk to Toban. 
*Talk to Toban again with dragon bones in your inventory to receive Relic part 3.
*Search the chest and take Toban's stolen gold.
**Take the rope if you need a second one.
*Talk to Grew back on the Jangerberry island.
**Take some jangerberries if needed.
*Go back and talk to Og.
*Talk to the Watchtower Wizard, who will put the three relics together and give you an ogre relic.
**Take the lit candle if a light source is needed.
}}

steps.title: The Skavids and the second crystal
steps.content:
- *Enter Gu'Tanoth via the path on the north-east corner of the hills, then head west towards the gate. Enter by talking to the Ogre Guard with the ogre relic in your inventory.
*Go south-east to the market in the central area and steal a rock cake from the counter on the southern side. 
** If you need a pestle and mortar and a vial, buy them from the Ogre merchant before stealing the rock cake. 
*Go back to the upper walkway, then head around south until you encounter guards at a battlement. Climb the battlement. 
*Talk to a City guard. 
*Talk to a City guard again with a death rune in your inventory to receive a skavid map.
*Return back across the bridges, over the battlement, and through the north-west gate where you entered the city.
*Walk east, then turn south towards the second city gate. 
*Enter the Skavid caves just north of the gate.
*Speak with the scared skavid. 
*Exit the cave, and speak with each regular Skavid inside the following 4 caves:
**East of Gu'Tanoth outside the city around the east side of the mountain.
**North-east of Gu'Tanoth along the main entrance path.
**North of Gu'Tanoth and south of the cluster of trees.
**North of Gu'Tanoth south of the west gate to Yanille. Grab one nightshade, which will complete an Ardougne Medium task.
*The following responses should work. The first part is what the Skavid says. You must respond with the second part:
**Tanath gor...Nod
**Bidith tanath...Cur
**Gor cur...Ar
**Cur bidith...Ig
*Exit the cave and go south to the Eastern City gate. Click on the gate to give a gold bar to the guard and gain access to the gate.
*Continue past the gate and across the bridge into the cave. Speak to the Mad Skavid, who will say one of these options. Repeat with the second part again.
**Ar cur...Gor
**Bidith ig...Cur
**Gor nod...Tanath
**Cur tanath...Bidith
**Bidith tanath...Cur
**Tanath gor...Nod
**Cur bidith...Ig
**Gor cur...Ar
*Take another cave nightshade. Make sure you have two of them. You can hop worlds for the second one.
*Leave the way you came in (do not climb down the hole).
*Return to the Gu'Tanoth market.
*Use one nightshade on one of the Enclave guards (be sure to complete the dialogue).
*Enter the cave and watch the cutscene.
*Teleport out or run north to the exit. 
}}

steps.title: The magic ogre potion
steps.content:
- *Go back to the Watchtower wizard and talk to him.
**If needed, fill a vial with water at the fountain in front of the watchtower.
*To a vial of water add in the following order (do not use the ground bat bones first or the water will evaporate and you will need more bones):
**Guam leaf – to make a guam potion (unf)
**Jangerberries (make sure to use, not eat)
**Ground bat bones (make sure to use, not bury)
***Use pestle and mortar on the bat bones now if you haven't already
*Talk to the Watchtower wizard again, with the unfinished potion in your inventory.

steps.title: Getting the other crystals
steps.content:
- *Prepare to defend yourself against the various ogres and a blue dragon in the Ogre Enclave. Don't forget your anti-dragon shield.
*Return to the market square of Gu'Tanoth.
*Use your nightshade on an Enclave guard to enter the cave again.
*Use the magic ogre potion on all 6 ogre shamans to get the 3rd crystal.
**The pouring animation is a stall, activate protection from melee before using the potion to avoid taking stacked hits from the demons and dragons in the area.
**You could aggro a skeleton or a spider to avoid taking hits from a dragon while using the potion.
*Right-click mine the Rock of Dalgroth in the centre of the Enclave for the 4th crystal.
*Talk to the Watchtower wizard and return the crystals. (Leave the room and return if crystals remain on pillars before you have placed them.)
**NE: Magenta
**SE: Grey
**SW: Yellow
**NW: Cyan
*Pull the lever to the west.
*Congratulations, quest complete!

steps.title: The Pebble
steps.content:
- *Enter the Tree Gnome Village maze.
** If you haven't started Tree Gnome Village yet, be sure to enter the village and start the quest so you won't have to redo the maze later on.
*Enter the dungeon at the end of the maze.
*Go east and search the off-coloured crate near the entrance of the room for a key.
*Go west and open the gate ("door") with the key.
*Speak to Golrie, he will give you Glarial's pebble.
** Keep the pebble in your bank for Roving Elves to save you some time in the future.

steps.title: Tomb Raiding
steps.content:
- *Bank all items EXCEPT Glarial's pebble, some food and a transport method ''(Runes won't be allowed since you won't be able to enter the tomb if you have anything deemed "not peaceful" in your possession; Jewellery is allowed including any jewellery that has any combat bonuses. You must have at least 2 open inventory spaces).''
** For low levels, as Glarial's Tomb is single-way combat, it is recommended to initiate combat with a skeleton once inside to prevent being attacked by Moss giants which damage the player significantly more.
** For Ultimate Ironmen there is a table (in the house you got Book on Baxtorian from) you can place your items on for temporary safe-keeping.
** If you die while in the tomb, your gravestone will spawn on the surface.
*Head to Glarial's Tombstone, east of the Waterfall. Use the pebble on it to enter.
*Go west, search the chest to find Glarial's amulet. (Pick-up an extra amulet or two by dropping it from your inventory and picking them up from the ground).
*Return and go the other way to search the tomb to find Glarial's urn.

steps.title: Baxtorian Treasures
steps.content:
''Items required: rope, 6 air runes, 6 water runes, 6 earth runes, Glarial's amulet and Glarial's urn, food.'' - *Head to the bank and get 6 air runes, 6 water runes, 6 earth runes, rope, some food, Glarial's amulet, and Glarial's urn. (Warning, there are several high level monsters in the waterfall dungeon.) Weapons and armour are also allowed in the cave, so feel free to get these back too.
*Make your way back to Baxtorian falls, board the raft, use your rope on the rock (across the water to the south), then use your rope on the dead tree. DO NOT GET IN THE BARREL.
*Carry/equip Glarial's amulet and enter the doorway.
*Go to the right path and search the northernmost crates for a key.
*Go back and to the left side, avoid the fire giants, use the key on the door.
** Killing a fire giant is a medium Kandarin Diary task.
*Use all 3 runes on each pillar (1 air, 1 water and 1 earth rune on each pillar).
**Use an additional rune on each pillar to check if that type has already been added, yielding the message: "You've already placed this type of rune on the pillar."
*After this, put Glarial's amulet on her statue. The ground will now rise to the chalice. Do not click Take treasure, as you will be washed out of the cave. 
*Use the Glarial's urn in your inventory on the chalice. (Make sure you have 5 free inventory slots).
*Congratulations, quest complete!

steps.title: The Crux Eqal
Monitoring Movario
steps.content:
- * Head to the Fight Arena just north of Yanille.
* Speak to the Khazard Launderer at the laundry house, two buildings north of the Fight Arena Bar. Charm the launderer with either the ring of Charos(a) or bribe him with 500 coins for information on Movario. ), and talk to the Hunting Expert ().  ( if you're 99 Hunter)
* Set up a pit trap to the west and bait it.
* Dismantle the trap to receive an unconscious broav, then return to the expert to have her train it.
* With the trained broav, head to the run-down house in the battlefield () where a broken table will be found. Drop the broav (not release) and use the dirty shirt on the broav; once it *squeals*, you will be able to right-click "Search" on the broken table.
* Climb-down the trapdoor to Movario's base.
* Run north-west, and search the open chest for a number of runes.
* Climb down the stairs.
* Inspect the old battered door, and pay close attention to the word "PROHIBITED"; one of the letters is stylised after a rune, which is the rune you must use to open the door, which is different for every player. 
**Warning: Using an incorrect rune will result in the door dealing 20+ damage to you. However, if you do choose incorrectly, the spell's colour indicates the correct rune:
